quote: A decrease in hematocrit level indicated that the level of erythrocyte also decreased and vice versa.
statement: 血细胞比容水平的降低表明红细胞水平也降低，反之亦然。
text_zh: 血细胞比容水平的降低表明红细胞水平也降低，反之亦然。
text_en: A decrease in hematocrit levels indicates a decrease in red blood cell levels, and vice versa.
outcome: 红细胞与血细胞比容的关系

quote: This is in accordance with a research of Baba et al. (2016) that the administration of Avena sativa extract, which was a preventive effort in controlling A. hydrophila infection, showed a higher hematocrit than the control.
statement: 这与Baba等人(2016)的研究一致，即作为控制嗜水气单胞菌感染的预防措施，给予燕麦提取物显示出比对照组更高的血细胞比容。
text_zh: 这与Baba等人(2016)的研究一致，即作为控制嗜水气单胞菌感染的预防措施，给予燕麦提取物显示出比对照组更高的血细胞比容。
text_en: This is consistent with the study by Baba et al. (2016), which showed that administering oat extract as a preventive measure against Aeromonas hydrophila infection resulted in higher hematocrit levels compared to the control group.
outcome: 抗感染能力与血细胞比容

quote: Overall, it also proved that the sea hare extract contained compounds that function as immunostimulants that could induce the resistance of the body toward the attack of A. hydrophila bacteria.
statement: 总体而言，这也证明了海兔提取物含有作为免疫刺激剂的化合物，可以诱导身体对嗜水气单胞菌攻击的抵抗力。
text_zh: 总体而言，这也证明了海兔提取物含有作为免疫刺激剂的化合物，可以诱导身体对嗜水气单胞菌攻击的抵抗力。
text_en: Overall, this also demonstrates that Aplysia extract contains compounds acting as immunostimulants that can induce resistance in the body against attacks by Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: The results of this study may provide information about the extract of D. auricularia contains secondary metabolites in the form of phenolic compounds, tannins, steroids, terpenoid, alkaloid, and saponin, which show their ability to stimulate fish health.
statement: 本研究结果可能提供关于耳状海兔提取物含有酚类、单宁、类固醇、萜类、生物碱和皂苷等次级代谢产物的信息，这些物质显示出刺激鱼类健康的能力。
text_zh: 本研究结果可能提供关于耳状海兔提取物含有酚类、单宁、类固醇、萜类、生物碱和皂苷等次级代谢产物的信息，这些物质显示出刺激鱼类健康的能力。
text_en: The results of this study may provide information that the Aplysia auris extract contains secondary metabolites such as phenols, tannins, steroids, terpenes, alkaloids and saponins, which show the ability to stimulate fish health.

quote: Administration of microencapsulated extract as much as 7 g/kg of feed was the optimum dose to stimulate the immunity of C. a. auratus against infection with A. hydrophilla bacteria as indicated by better clinical symptoms of fish, blood profile, relative percent survival, and weight gain.
statement: 在饲料中添加7克/千克的微胶囊化提取物是刺激金鱼（C. a. auratus）对嗜水气单胞菌感染免疫力的最佳剂量，表现为鱼类的临床症状改善、血液指标、相对存活率和体重增加更好。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加7克/千克的微胶囊化提取物是刺激金鱼（C. a. auratus）对嗜水气单胞菌感染免疫力的最佳剂量，表现为鱼类的临床症状改善、血液指标、相对存活率和体重增加更好。
text_en: Adding 7 g/kg of microencapsulated extract to the feed is the optimal dose for stimulating immunity in goldfish (C. a. auratus) against Aeromonas hydrophila infection, as evidenced by improved clinical symptoms, blood parameters, relative survival rate, and weight gain.

quote: In conclusion, our results suggest that D. auricularia biota can be developed to be used in controlling disease in aquaculture.
statement: 总之，我们的结果表明耳状海兔生物资源可以开发用于控制水产养殖中的疾病。
text_zh: 总之，我们的结果表明耳状海兔生物资源可以开发用于控制水产养殖中的疾病。
text_en: In conclusion, our results indicate that the biological resources of Aplysia auriculiformis can be developed for disease control in aquaculture.

quote:
According to Azlan et al. (2021)
that the increase in leukocytes after infection is an
indication that the defense system of fish gives responses to
pathogens that enter the body.
statement: 感染后白细胞增加表明鱼类的防御系统对进入体内的病原体做出了反应。
text_zh: 感染后白细胞增加表明鱼类的防御系统对进入体内的病原体做出了反应。
text_en: The increase in white blood cells after infection indicates that the fish's defense system has responded to pathogens entering the body.

quote:
The stimulation of the immune system of fish and its ability
to respond to bacterial infection is predicted because the
sea hare extract contains phenolics, steroids, terpenoid,
alkaloid, saponin, and tannin.
statement: 预测海兔提取物刺激鱼类免疫系统及其应对细菌感染的能力是因为其含有酚类、类固醇、萜类、生物碱、皂苷和单宁。
text_zh: 预测海兔提取物刺激鱼类免疫系统及其应对细菌感染的能力是因为其含有酚类、类固醇、萜类、生物碱、皂苷和单宁。
text_en: The ability of Aplysia extract to stimulate the fish immune system and respond to bacterial infection is predicted because it contains phenols, steroids, terpenes, alkaloids, saponins, and tannins.

quote:
According to Alexander and Supp (2014), arginine can
influence the secretion of growth hormones in terms of
accelerating wound healing.
statement: 精氨酸可通过影响生长激素分泌来加速伤口愈合。
text_zh: 精氨酸可通过影响生长激素分泌来加速伤口愈合。
text_en: Arginine can accelerate wound healing by affecting growth hormone secretion.

quote:
Akinpelu et al.
(2014) stated that saponin could prevent damage caused by
free radicals and infection caused by pathogenic bacteria.
statement: 皂苷可以防止由自由基引起的损伤和由致病菌引起的感染。
text_zh: 皂苷可以防止由自由基引起的损伤和由致病菌引起的感染。
text_en: Saponins can prevent damage caused by free radicals and infections caused by pathogenic bacteria.

quote:
This was as
well the case even after being infected with A. hydrophila
bacteria.
statement: 即使在感染嗜水气单胞菌细菌后，情况也是如此（指红细胞增加）。
text_zh: 即使在感染嗜水气单胞菌细菌后，情况也是如此（指红细胞增加）。
text_en: This was also the case (referring to an increase in red blood cells) even after infection with Aeromonas hydrophila bacteria.

quote:
Similar to two data above, the C. a. auratus fed with a
diet contained of 7.7 g extract D. auricularia /kg feed had
the highest of hematocrit level compared to other
treatments.
statement: 与前两项数据类似，喂食含有7.7克木耳提取物/公斤饲料的金鱼与其他处理组相比具有最高的血细胞比容水平。
text_zh: 与前两项数据类似，喂食含有7.7克木耳提取物/公斤饲料的金鱼与其他处理组相比具有最高的血细胞比容水平。
text_en: Similar to the previous two data points, goldfish fed a diet containing 7.7 g of Auricularia extract/kg feed had the highest hematocrit levels compared with other treatment groups.
intervention_record: 木耳提取物微胶囊饲料

quote:
Despite being the C. a.
auratus infected with A. hydrophila bacteria increased level
was still observed.
statement: 尽管金鱼感染了嗜水气单胞菌细菌，但仍观察到水平升高。
text_zh: 尽管金鱼感染了嗜水气单胞菌细菌，但仍观察到水平升高。
text_en: Although goldfish were infected with Aeromonas hydrophila bacteria, elevated levels were still observed.

quote:
Data in Table 4 shows that the average
hemoglobin level, after the administration of microcapsules
extracts for 30 days, had increased, and so was the case
even being infected with A. hydrophila bacteria.
statement: 表4中的数据表明，在给予微胶囊提取物30天后，平均血红蛋白水平有所增加，即使感染嗜水气单胞菌细菌也是如此。
text_zh: 表4中的数据表明，在给予微胶囊提取物30天后，平均血红蛋白水平有所增加，即使感染嗜水气单胞菌细菌也是如此。
text_en: The data in Table 4 show that after 30 days of administration of the microencapsulated extract, average hemoglobin levels increased, even when infected with Aeromonas hydrophila bacteria.

quote:
Data of weight gain of C. a. auratus presented in Figure
2 shows that the highest of weight gain was found in fish
fed with the feed contained 7.7 g extract/kg feed, followed
by the treatment of 7 g extract/kg feed, and lastly, 6.3 g
extract/ kg feed.
statement: 图2中展示的金鱼体重增加数据显示，喂食含7.7克提取物/公斤饲料的鱼体重增加最多，其次是7克和6.3克的处理组。
text_zh: 图2中展示的金鱼体重增加数据显示，喂食含7.7克提取物/公斤饲料的鱼体重增加最多，其次是7克和6.3克的处理组。
text_en: The goldfish body weight gain data shown in Figure 2 indicate that fish fed diets containing 7.7 g extract/kg feed had the highest body weight gain, followed by the 7 g and 6.3 g treatment groups.

quote: The results of research in terms of the weight gain in C. a. auratus showed that the addition of microcapsules of sea hare extract in the feed gave a significantly different influence between treatments (Figure 3).
statement: 在饲料中添加海兔提取物微胶囊对C. a. auratus的体重增加有显著影响。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加海兔提取物微胶囊对C. a. auratus的体重增加有显著影响。
text_en: Adding Aplysia extract microcapsules to feed had a significant effect on the weight gain of C. a. auratus.

quote: Based on these data, it could be indicated that C. a. auratus were not in stressful conditions so that the energy for their growth could be used properly.
statement: 数据表明C. a. auratus未处于应激状态，因此能量能正常用于生长。
text_zh: 数据表明C. a. auratus未处于应激状态，因此能量能正常用于生长。
text_en: The data indicate that C. a. auratus is not in a state of stress, so energy can be normally used for growth.

quote: Deane and Woo (2009) explained that stressed fish caused the growth of hormones to decrease.
statement: 受应激的鱼会导致激素生长减少。
text_zh: 受应激的鱼会导致激素生长减少。
text_en: Stressed fish lead to reduced hormonal growth.

quote: Based on that issue, it was indicated that the addition of microcapsules of sea hare extract in the feed could increase the weight gain of C. a. auratus.
statement: 在饲料中添加海兔提取物微胶囊可以增加C. a. auratus的体重增加。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加海兔提取物微胶囊可以增加C. a. auratus的体重增加。
text_en: Adding Aplysia extract microcapsules to feed can increase the weight gain of C. a. auratus.

quote: The observation results of relative percent survival (RPS) showed that both treatments 7 extract/kg feed and 7.7 g extract/kg feed were the treatments with the highest RPS value (Table 5).
statement: 相对存活率观察结果显示，7克/公斤饲料和7.7克/公斤饲料的处理组具有最高的RPS值。
text_zh: 相对存活率观察结果显示，7克/公斤饲料和7.7克/公斤饲料的处理组具有最高的RPS值。
text_en: The observed relative percent survival (RPS) results showed that the treatment groups with 7 g/kg feed and 7.7 g/kg feed had the highest RPS values.
intervention: Different doses of sea hare extract

quote: This statement is also supported by Fazio et al. (2015), which stated that the increase of erythrocyte levels in the blood indicated that hemoglobin level increased and it also indicated that the stress in fish might be due to splenic contraction.
statement: Fazio等人(2015)指出，血液中红细胞水平的增加表明血红蛋白水平升高，这也可能表明鱼类应激源于脾脏收缩。
text_zh: Fazio等人(2015)指出，血液中红细胞水平的增加表明血红蛋白水平升高，这也可能表明鱼类应激源于脾脏收缩。
text_en: Fazio et al. (2015) noted that an increase in blood red blood cell levels indicates elevated hemoglobin levels, which may also suggest that fish stress originates from spleen contraction.

quote: Parrino et al. (2018) state that environmental stress impact on hemoglobin oxygen-binding properties.
statement: Parrino等人(2018)指出，环境应激影响血红蛋白的氧结合特性。
text_zh: Parrino等人(2018)指出，环境应激影响血红蛋白的氧结合特性。
text_en: Parrino et al. (2018) indicated that environmental stress affects the oxygen-binding properties of hemoglobin.
outcome: 环境应激对血液功能的影响

quote: From the results of observation, the treatment of 7.7 g of extract per/feed was the best treatment compared to the other treatments.
statement: 观察结果显示，每千克饲料添加7.7克提取物的处理优于其他处理。
text_zh: 观察结果显示，每千克饲料添加7.7克提取物的处理优于其他处理。
text_en: The observation results showed that the treatment with 7.7 grams of extract per kilogram of feed was superior to other treatments.
intervention_record: 每千克饲料添加7.7克海兔提取物

quote: The observation results of hemoglobin level on the 37th day or after the challenge test using A. hydrophila bacteria increased in both treatments, namely 7 g extract per/feed and 7.7 g extract per/feed.
statement: 在第37天或使用嗜水气单胞菌进行攻击测试后，每千克饲料添加7克和7.7克提取物的两种处理中，血红蛋白水平均有所增加。
text_zh: 在第37天或使用嗜水气单胞菌进行攻击测试后，每千克饲料添加7克和7.7克提取物的两种处理中，血红蛋白水平均有所增加。
text_en: On day 37 or after challenge testing with Aeromonas hydrophila, hemoglobin levels increased in both treatments where 7 g and 7.7 g of extract per kg of feed were added.
outcome: 抗病力/应激后的血液恢复

quote: whereas in the treatment of 6.3 g extract per kg of feed, there was a decrease in hemoglobin level when compared to the 30th day.
statement: 而在每千克饲料添加6.3克提取物的处理中，与第30天相比，血红蛋白水平下降。
text_zh: 而在每千克饲料添加6.3克提取物的处理中，与第30天相比，血红蛋白水平下降。
text_en: In the treatment with 6.3 grams of extract per kilogram of feed, hemoglobin levels decreased compared to day 30.
intervention_record: 每千克饲料添加6.3克海兔提取物
outcome: 血液指标（血红蛋白）恶化

quote: Low hemoglobin level or outside the normal range indicated that the process of hematopoiesis in C. a. auratus started to be disrupted or hampered because of the interference after being tested by a challenge test with A. hydrophila bacteria.
statement: 低血红蛋白水平或超出正常范围表明，由于嗜水气单胞菌攻击测试后的干扰，C. a. auratus的造血过程开始受到破坏或阻碍。
text_zh: 低血红蛋白水平或超出正常范围表明，由于嗜水气单胞菌攻击测试后的干扰，C. a. auratus的造血过程开始受到破坏或阻碍。
text_en: Low hemoglobin levels or values outside the normal range indicate that the hematopoietic process of C. a. auratus began to be disrupted or hindered due to interference following the Aeromonas hydrophila challenge test.

quote: The water was filtered and aerated; the bottom of the aquarium was covered with sand and potted water plants (genus: Cryptocoryne).
statement: The water was filtered and aerated, and the aquarium bottom was covered with sand and potted water plants.
text_en: The water was filtered and aerated, and the aquarium bottom was covered with sand and potted water plants.

quote: The individuals were fed frozen mosquito larvae and fish food flakes.
statement: The individuals were fed frozen mosquito larvae and fish food flakes.
text_en: The individuals were fed frozen mosquito larvae and fish food flakes.

quote: A single triploid and seven randomly chosen diploid representatives were sacrificed and used for cytogenetic investigation
statement: One triploid and seven diploid individuals were sacrificed for cytogenetic investigation.
text_en: One triploid and seven diploid individuals were sacrificed for cytogenetic investigation.

quote: According to Grisez and Tan (2005), a successful vaccination has a minimum RPS value of 60% in fish.
statement: 根据Grisez和Tan（2005年），鱼类成功疫苗接种的最低RPS值为60%。
text_zh: 根据Grisez和Tan（2005年），鱼类成功疫苗接种的最低RPS值为60%。
text_en: According to Grisez and Tan (2005), the minimum RPS value for successful fish vaccination is 60%.

quote: It also proved that those two doses of treatment could work effectively in C. a. auratus to prevent diseases caused by A. hydrophilla bacterial infection.
statement: 这也证明了这两种剂量的处理能有效预防由嗜水气单胞菌感染引起的疾病。
text_zh: 这也证明了这两种剂量的处理能有效预防由嗜水气单胞菌感染引起的疾病。
text_en: This also proves that treatments at these two doses can effectively prevent diseases caused by Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: In this research, the highest total mortality data was found in the control treatment.
statement: 在本研究中，对照组的总死亡率数据最高。
text_zh: 在本研究中，对照组的总死亡率数据最高。
text_en: In this study, the control group had the highest total mortality data.

quote: It was because this group was not treated in the form of microcapsules of sea hare extract, which has functioned as an immunostimulant so that it was not resistant to the attack of A. hydrophila bacteria.
statement: 这是因为该组未接受海兔提取物微胶囊形式的处理，而海兔提取物作为免疫刺激剂发挥作用，使其对嗜水气单胞菌的攻击没有抵抗力。
text_zh: 这是因为该组未接受海兔提取物微胶囊形式的处理，而海兔提取物作为免疫刺激剂发挥作用，使其对嗜水气单胞菌的攻击没有抵抗力。
text_en: This is because the group did not receive treatment in the form of microencapsulated Aplysia extract, and Aplysia extract acts as an immunostimulant, making them resistant to attacks by Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: On the other hand, there were no fish that died or were infected with A. hydrophila bacteria in both treatments of 7 g extract/kg feed and 7.7 g extract/kg feed, it was proven by the condition of fish which were in good health and without clinical symptoms.
statement: 另一方面，在7克提取物/公斤饲料和7.7克提取物/公斤饲料的两个处理组中，没有鱼死亡或感染嗜水气单胞菌，这通过鱼的健康状况和无临床症状得到证明。
text_zh: 另一方面，在7克提取物/公斤饲料和7.7克提取物/公斤饲料的两个处理组中，没有鱼死亡或感染嗜水气单胞菌，这通过鱼的健康状况和无临床症状得到证明。
text_en: On the other hand, in the two treatment groups with 7 g extract/kg feed and 7.7 g extract/kg feed, no fish died or were infected with Aeromonas hydrophila, as demonstrated by the health status of the fish and the absence of clinical symptoms.

quote: At 48 h, the nitrite concentrations in the NaCl compound group (0.63 mg/L) and eugenol compound group (0.56 mg/L) were significantly higher than those in the control group (0.47 mg/L), ginger group (0.44 mg/L), and microcapsule group (0.44 mg/L).
statement: 在运输48小时后，NaCl复合组和丁香酚复合组水中的亚硝酸盐浓度显著高于对照组、姜组和微胶囊组。
text_zh: 在运输48小时后，NaCl复合组和丁香酚复合组水中的亚硝酸盐浓度显著高于对照组、姜组和微胶囊组。
text_en: After 48 hours of transport, the nitrite concentrations in the water of the NaCl composite group and the eugenol composite group were significantly higher than those in the control group, the ginger group, and the microcapsule group.

quote: The possible reason is that the addition of NaCl changes the salinity of the water and affects the activity of nitrifying bacteria, while eugenol, although having certain antibacterial and antioxidant effects, may not have a significant effect on promoting the nitrification process.
statement: 作者推测NaCl改变盐度影响硝化细菌活性，而丁香酚虽具抗菌抗氧化作用但可能不促进硝化过程，导致亚硝酸盐升高。
text_zh: 作者推测NaCl改变盐度影响硝化细菌活性，而丁香酚虽具抗菌抗氧化作用但可能不促进硝化过程，导致亚硝酸盐升高。
text_en: The authors speculate that NaCl alters salinity and affects nitrifying bacteria activity, while eugenol, although having antibacterial and antioxidant effects, may not promote the nitrification process, leading to increased nitrite levels.

quote: In contrast, after 48 h of transportation, the TDS levels in the ginger group, microcapsule group, and eugenol compound group were significantly lower than that of the control group
statement: 运输48小时后，姜组、微胶囊组和丁香酚复合组的TDS水平显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 运输48小时后，姜组、微胶囊组和丁香酚复合组的TDS水平显著低于对照组。
text_en: After 48 hours of transport, the TDS levels in the ginger group, microcapsule group, and eugenol composite group were significantly lower than those in the control group.

quote: The rapid expansion of e-commerce logistics has led to the growing adoption of individual live fish transportation as a preferred method for fresh food delivery
statement: 电子商务物流的快速发展导致个体活鱼运输成为生鲜食品配送的首选方法。
text_zh: 电子商务物流的快速发展导致个体活鱼运输成为生鲜食品配送的首选方法。
text_en: The rapid development of e-commerce logistics has led to individual live fish transport becoming the preferred method for fresh food delivery.

quote: this process inevitably exposes fish to a range of environmental stressors, such as heat [ 2 ], hypoxia [ 3 ], and ammonia nitrogen [ 4 ], which can trigger strong physiological stress responses, thereby leading to oxidative stress, metabolic disturbances, muscle quality deteriorate, and increased mortality rates post-transport
statement: 该过程使鱼类暴露于高温、缺氧和氨氮等环境胁迫下，引发强烈的生理应激反应，导致氧化应激、代谢紊乱、肌肉品质下降以及运输后死亡率增加。
text_zh: 该过程使鱼类暴露于高温、缺氧和氨氮等环境胁迫下，引发强烈的生理应激反应，导致氧化应激、代谢紊乱、肌肉品质下降以及运输后死亡率增加。
text_en: This process exposes fish to environmental stressors such as high temperature, hypoxia, and ammonia nitrogen, triggering a strong physiological stress response that leads to oxidative stress, metabolic disorders, reduced muscle quality, and increased post-transport mortality.

quote: NaCl addition is a widely used method that helps maintain osmotic balance, improving water quality (e.g., reducing ammonia toxicity) and suppressing pathogen proliferation (e.g., through ionic stress on microbes), thereby alleviated stress
statement: 添加氯化钠是一种广泛使用的方法，有助于维持渗透平衡，改善水质（如降低氨毒性）并抑制病原体增殖（如通过离子胁迫作用于微生物），从而缓解应激。
text_zh: 添加氯化钠是一种广泛使用的方法，有助于维持渗透平衡，改善水质（如降低氨毒性）并抑制病原体增殖（如通过离子胁迫作用于微生物），从而缓解应激。
text_en: Adding sodium chloride is a widely used method that helps maintain osmotic balance, improve water quality (such as reducing ammonia toxicity), and inhibit pathogen proliferation (such as through ionic stress on microorganisms), thereby alleviating stress.
outcome: 渗透压调节与应激缓解

quote: For instance, moderate salinity levels (2–4 g/L) have been shown to reduce cortisol and glucose levels and enhance antioxidant responses in freshwater species
statement: 例如，中等盐度水平（2–4 g/L）已被证明能降低淡水物种的皮质醇和葡萄糖水平，并增强抗氧化反应。
text_zh: 例如，中等盐度水平（2–4 g/L）已被证明能降低淡水物种的皮质醇和葡萄糖水平，并增强抗氧化反应。
text_en: For example, moderate salinity levels (2–4 g/L) have been shown to reduce cortisol and glucose levels in freshwater species and enhance antioxidant responses.
outcome: 激素水平与抗氧化能力

quote: Another effective approach involves the use of natural anesthetics, such as eugenol, which have been proven to reduce oxidative damage and muscle quality deterioration in fish by slowing down metabolism during transport
statement: 另一种有效方法是使用天然麻醉剂，如丁香酚，已证明其通过在运输过程中减缓代谢来减少鱼类的氧化损伤和肌肉品质恶化。
text_zh: 另一种有效方法是使用天然麻醉剂，如丁香酚，已证明其通过在运输过程中减缓代谢来减少鱼类的氧化损伤和肌肉品质恶化。
text_en: Another effective method is the use of natural anesthetics, such as eugenol, which has been shown to reduce oxidative damage and deterioration of muscle quality in fish by slowing metabolism during transport.

quote: Furthermore, Chen et al. [ 9 ] have been reported that different compound of anti-stress substances (NaCl, eugenol, and vitamin C (Vc)) can alleviate stress and improve muscle quality.
statement: 此外，Chen等人报道了不同的抗应激物质复合物（氯化钠、丁香酚和维生素C）可以缓解应激并改善肌肉品质。
text_zh: 此外，Chen等人报道了不同的抗应激物质复合物（氯化钠、丁香酚和维生素C）可以缓解应激并改善肌肉品质。
text_en: In addition, Chen et al. reported that different anti-stress substance complexes (sodium chloride, eugenol and vitamin C) can alleviate stress and improve muscle quality.

quote: This study aimed to evaluate the application efficacy of four methods of ginger exact—direct addition, microencapsulation, and combinations with NaCl or eugenol—in improving the survival rate, stress resistance, and muscle quality of crucian carp (Carassius auratus) during transportation of individual packaging.
statement: 本研究旨在评估四种姜提取物给药方法（直接添加、微胶囊化以及与氯化钠或丁香酚的组合）在提高单独包装运输过程中鲫鱼存活率、抗压能力和肌肉品质方面的应用效果。
text_zh: 本研究旨在评估四种姜提取物给药方法（直接添加、微胶囊化以及与氯化钠或丁香酚的组合）在提高单独包装运输过程中鲫鱼存活率、抗压能力和肌肉品质方面的应用效果。
text_en: This study aims to evaluate the application effects of four ginger extract administration methods (direct addition, microencapsulation, and combinations with sodium chloride or eugenol) on improving survival rate, stress resistance, and muscle quality of crucian carp during individual packaging transport.
intervention_record: 姜提取物不同给药方式
outcome: 存活率、应激抵抗与肌肉品质

quote: hsp70 and hsp90 were lower in the ginger group, microcapsule group, and eugenol compound group, indicating that these treatment methods can effectively alleviate oxidative stress in fish during transportation.
statement: 生姜组、微胶囊组和丁香酚复合组的hsp70和hsp90水平较低，表明这些处理方法能有效缓解鱼类运输过程中的氧化应激。
text_zh: 生姜组、微胶囊组和丁香酚复合组的hsp70和hsp90水平较低，表明这些处理方法能有效缓解鱼类运输过程中的氧化应激。
text_en: The hsp70 and hsp90 levels in the ginger group, microcapsule group, and eugenol complex group were lower, indicating that these treatments effectively alleviated oxidative stress during fish transport.

quote: Although the NaCl compound group showed slightly higher hsp90 expression than other treatment groups, the overall stress level was still lower than that of the control group.
statement: 尽管氯化钠复合组的hsp90表达量略高于其他处理组，但整体应激水平仍低于对照组。
text_zh: 尽管氯化钠复合组的hsp90表达量略高于其他处理组，但整体应激水平仍低于对照组。
text_en: Although the hsp90 expression level in the sodium chloride complex group was slightly higher than that in other treatment groups, the overall stress level remained lower than that in the control group.

quote: caspase 3 were the lowest in the microcapsule group and the eugenol compound group, indicating that the microcapsule group and the eugenol compound group can more effectively inhibit cell apoptosis
statement: 微胶囊组和丁香酚复合组的caspase 3水平最低，表明这两组能更有效地抑制细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 微胶囊组和丁香酚复合组的caspase 3水平最低，表明这两组能更有效地抑制细胞凋亡。
text_en: The microcapsule group and the eugenol complex group had the lowest caspase 3 levels, indicating that these two groups were more effective in inhibiting apoptosis.

quote: The lowest expression level of il-6 was observed in the compound group of eugenol, indicating that the compound group of eugenol has a more significant anti-inflammatory effect
statement: 在丁香酚复合组中观察到il-6的表达水平最低，表明丁香酚复合组具有更显著的抗炎作用。
text_zh: 在丁香酚复合组中观察到il-6的表达水平最低，表明丁香酚复合组具有更显著的抗炎作用。
text_en: The lowest expression level of il-6 was observed in the eugenol compound group, indicating that the eugenol compound group has a more significant anti-inflammatory effect.

quote: The high levels of caspase 3 and il-6 in the NaCl compound group indicate that the use of NaCl to some extent exacerbates cellular stress and dehydration, increasing inflammatory response and cell apoptosis.
statement: 氯化钠复合组中较高的caspase 3和il-6水平表明，使用氯化钠在一定程度上加剧了细胞应激和脱水，增加了炎症反应和细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 氯化钠复合组中较高的caspase 3和il-6水平表明，使用氯化钠在一定程度上加剧了细胞应激和脱水，增加了炎症反应和细胞凋亡。
text_en: The higher levels of caspase 3 and IL-6 in the sodium chloride composite group indicate that the use of sodium chloride exacerbated cellular stress and dehydration to some extent, increasing inflammatory response and apoptosis.

quote: after 48 h of transportation, the gill filaments in the control group were severely damaged and swollen and ruptured. The liver tissue exhibited extensive cellular damage, with large, continuous vacuolated regions and loosely arranged, disordered hepatocytes. All treatment groups alleviated
statement: 运输48小时后，对照组的鳃丝严重受损、肿胀和破裂；肝脏组织表现出广泛的细胞损伤，有大片连续的空泡化区域以及排列松散、紊乱的肝细胞；所有处理组均有所缓解。
text_zh: 运输48小时后，对照组的鳃丝严重受损、肿胀和破裂；肝脏组织表现出广泛的细胞损伤，有大片连续的空泡化区域以及排列松散、紊乱的肝细胞；所有处理组均有所缓解。
text_en: After 48 hours of transport, the gill filaments in the control group showed severe damage, swelling and rupture; liver tissue exhibited extensive cellular damage, with large continuous areas of vacuolization and loosely arranged, disordered hepatocytes; all treatment groups showed alleviation.

quote: Therefore, the eugenol compound and microcapsule group exhibited a higher survival rate compared to the other groups (Figure 2).
statement: 丁香酚复合物组和微胶囊组的存活率高于其他组。
text_zh: 丁香酚复合物组和微胶囊组的存活率高于其他组。
text_en: The survival rate of the eugenol complex group and the microcapsule group was higher than that of the other groups.

quote: After 72 h of transport, the survival rate of the control group dropped to 0, while the ginger extract group and the NaCl compound group-maintained survival rates of 20% and 30%, respectively.
statement: 运输72小时后，对照组存活率降至0，而姜提取物组和NaCl复合物组的存活率分别为20%和30%。
text_zh: 运输72小时后，对照组存活率降至0，而姜提取物组和NaCl复合物组的存活率分别为20%和30%。
text_en: After 72 hours of transport, the survival rate in the control group dropped to 0, while the survival rates in the ginger extract group and the NaCl complex group were 20% and 30%, respectively.

quote: This suggests that either ginger extract alone or in combination with NaCl provides limited effective during prolonged transportation.
statement: 这表明单独使用姜提取物或与NaCl联合使用在长时间运输中效果有限。
text_zh: 这表明单独使用姜提取物或与NaCl联合使用在长时间运输中效果有限。
text_en: This indicates that the use of ginger extract alone or in combination with NaCl has limited effects during long-term transport.

quote: In contrast, the microcapsule group and the eugenol compound group exhibited the highest survival rates, indicating that these two treatments offer superior anti-stress effects and can significantly improve the survival of fish during long-term transport.
statement: 相比之下，微胶囊组和丁香酚复合物组表现出最高的存活率，表明这两种处理提供了优越的抗应激效果，并能显著提高鱼类在长期运输中的存活率。
text_zh: 相比之下，微胶囊组和丁香酚复合物组表现出最高的存活率，表明这两种处理提供了优越的抗应激效果，并能显著提高鱼类在长期运输中的存活率。
text_en: In contrast, the microcapsule group and the eugenol complex group showed the highest survival rates, indicating that these two treatments provided superior anti-stress effects and significantly improved fish survival during long-term transport.

quote: The dissolved oxygen level in the water exhibited an initial rise followed by a decline with prolonged transportation, as illustrated in Figure 3 A.
statement: 水中的溶解氧水平随着运输时间的延长呈现先升后降的趋势。
text_zh: 水中的溶解氧水平随着运输时间的延长呈现先升后降的趋势。
text_en: The dissolved oxygen level in the water showed a trend of first rising and then falling as transport time increased.

quote: Notably, the highest dissolved oxygen concentration was observed at 24 h. This can be attributed to the early stage of transportation, during which the rate of oxygen dissolution into the water exceeded the total oxygen consumption by both fish and microorganisms.
statement: 值得注意的是，在24小时观察到最高的溶解氧浓度，这归因于运输早期阶段氧气溶入水的速率超过了鱼和微生物的总耗氧量。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，在24小时观察到最高的溶解氧浓度，这归因于运输早期阶段氧气溶入水的速率超过了鱼和微生物的总耗氧量。
text_en: It is worth noting that the highest dissolved oxygen concentration was observed at 24 hours, which is attributed to the rate of oxygen dissolving into the water during the early stage of transport exceeding the total oxygen consumption by fish and microorganisms.

quote: After 48 h of live transport, the concentrations in the ginger extract group, microcapsule group, NaCl compound group, and eugenol compound group were slightly higher than that of the control group, measuring 3.27, 3.07, 2.70, and 3.20 mg/L, respectively. However, these differences were not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
statement: 活体运输48小时后，姜提取物组、微胶囊组、NaCl复合物组和丁香酚复合物组的浓度略高于对照组，分别为3.27、3.07、2.70和3.20 mg/L，但这些差异无统计学意义。
text_zh: 活体运输48小时后，姜提取物组、微胶囊组、NaCl复合物组和丁香酚复合物组的浓度略高于对照组，分别为3.27、3.07、2.70和3.20 mg/L，但这些差异无统计学意义。
text_en: After 48 hours of live transport, the concentrations in the ginger extract group, microcapsule group, NaCl complex group, and eugenol complex group were slightly higher than those in the control group, at 3.27, 3.07, 2.70, and 3.20 mg/L respectively, but these differences were not statistically significant.

quote: In recent years, plant-derived bioactive compounds have gained increasing attention for their potential in stress mitigation during fish transport
statement: 近年来，植物源生物活性化合物因其在鱼类运输期间缓解应激的潜力而受到越来越多的关注。
text_zh: 近年来，植物源生物活性化合物因其在鱼类运输期间缓解应激的潜力而受到越来越多的关注。
text_en: In recent years, plant-derived bioactive compounds have received increasing attention due to their potential to alleviate stress during fish transport.

quote: These properties make it a promising candidate for alleviating transport-induced stress in aquaculture species.
statement: 这些特性使其成为缓解水产养殖物种运输诱导应激的有前景候选物。
text_zh: 这些特性使其成为缓解水产养殖物种运输诱导应激的有前景候选物。
text_en: These properties make it a promising candidate for alleviating transport-induced stress in aquaculture species.

quote: However, the application of ginger extract in live fish transport remains limited by challenges such as rapid degradation and short duration of action when administered directly into water.
statement: 然而，生姜提取物在活鱼运输中的应用仍受到挑战的限制，例如直接加入水中时降解迅速和作用持续时间短。
text_zh: 然而，生姜提取物在活鱼运输中的应用仍受到挑战的限制，例如直接加入水中时降解迅速和作用持续时间短。
text_en: However, the application of ginger extract in live fish transport is still limited by challenges such as rapid degradation and short duration of action when added directly to water.
intervention: Ginger extract added directly to water
intervention_record: 姜提取物直接加入水中
limitations: rapid degradation; short duration of action

quote: This study evaluated the effects of ginger extract, applied via four methods—direct addition, microencapsulation, and combinations with NaCl or eugenol—on stress responses and muscle quality in crucian carp during transportation.
statement: 本研究评估了生姜提取物通过四种方法（直接添加、微胶囊化以及与NaCl或丁香酚的组合）对运输过程中鲫鱼应激反应和肌肉品质的影响。
text_zh: 本研究评估了生姜提取物通过四种方法（直接添加、微胶囊化以及与NaCl或丁香酚的组合）对运输过程中鲫鱼应激反应和肌肉品质的影响。
text_en: This study evaluated the effects of ginger extract applied via four methods (direct addition, microencapsulation, and combinations with NaCl or eugenol) on stress responses and muscle quality in crucian carp during transport.
intervention_record: 姜提取物不同给药方式

quote: Among the treatments, microcapsules and the eugenol compound showed the best results, each achieving a 50% survival rate after 72 h.
statement: 在各处理组中，微胶囊组和丁香酚化合物组效果最好，均在72小时后达到50%的存活率。
text_zh: 在各处理组中，微胶囊组和丁香酚化合物组效果最好，均在72小时后达到50%的存活率。
text_en: Among the treatment groups, the microcapsule group and the eugenol compound group performed best, both reaching a 50% survival rate after 72 hours.
intervention_record: 微胶囊化姜提取物/丁香酚

quote: The microcapsule group provided prolonged antioxidant protection, stabilized water quality, reduced cortisol levels, suppressed pro-apoptotic gene expression (hsp70 , hsp90 , il-6 , caspase 3 , caspase 8 , and bax), while upregulating the anti-apoptotic gene bcl-2 .
statement: 微胶囊组提供了持久的抗氧化保护，稳定了水质，降低了皮质醇水平，抑制了促凋亡基因表达（hsp70, hsp90, il-6, caspase 3, caspase 8 和 bax），同时上调了抗凋亡基因 bcl-2。
text_zh: 微胶囊组提供了持久的抗氧化保护，稳定了水质，降低了皮质醇水平，抑制了促凋亡基因表达（hsp70, hsp90, il-6, caspase 3, caspase 8 和 bax），同时上调了抗凋亡基因 bcl-2。
text_en: The microcapsule group provided sustained antioxidant protection, stabilized water quality, reduced cortisol levels, inhibited pro-apoptotic gene expression (hsp70, hsp90, il-6, caspase 3, caspase 8 and bax), while upregulating the anti-apoptotic gene bcl-2.
outcome: 抗氧化能力、水质稳定性、激素水平及基因表达

quote: These alterations contributed to lower lactic acid accumulation and glycogen consumption, enhanced muscle shear force, reduced drip loss, and improved structural integrity of the gill, liver, and muscle tissues.
statement: 这些变化有助于降低乳酸积累和糖原消耗，增强肌肉剪切力，减少滴水损失，并改善鳃、肝脏和肌肉组织的结构完整性。
text_zh: 这些变化有助于降低乳酸积累和糖原消耗，增强肌肉剪切力，减少滴水损失，并改善鳃、肝脏和肌肉组织的结构完整性。
text_en: These changes help reduce lactate accumulation and glycogen consumption, enhance muscle shear force, decrease drip loss, and improve the structural integrity of gill, liver, and muscle tissues.
outcome: 代谢指标、肌肉物理特性及组织完整性

quote: The eugenol group effectively limited ammonia nitrogen accumulation, decreased glutathione peroxidase activity, and downregulated stress and apoptosis-related genes (bax, caspase 3 , and caspase 9), resulting in reduced tissue damage.
statement: 丁香酚组有效限制了氨氮积累，降低了谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性，并下调了应激和凋亡相关基因（bax, caspase 3 和 caspase 9），从而减少了组织损伤。
text_zh: 丁香酚组有效限制了氨氮积累，降低了谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性，并下调了应激和凋亡相关基因（bax, caspase 3 和 caspase 9），从而减少了组织损伤。
text_en: The eugenol group effectively limited ammonia nitrogen accumulation, reduced glutathione peroxidase activity, and downregulated stress- and apoptosis-related genes (bax, caspase 3, and caspase 9), thereby reducing tissue damage.
intervention_record: 姜提取物与丁香酚组合
outcome: 水质指标、酶活性、基因表达及组织损伤

quote: In contrast, the NaCl compound group accelerated water quality deterioration, increased TDS (total dissolved solids), lowered dissolved oxygen, and weakened stress resistance, leading to more severe tissue damage.
statement: 相比之下，NaCl复合组加速了水质恶化，增加了总溶解固体（TDS），降低了溶解氧，削弱了应激抵抗力，导致更严重的组织损伤。
text_zh: 相比之下，NaCl复合组加速了水质恶化，增加了总溶解固体（TDS），降低了溶解氧，削弱了应激抵抗力，导致更严重的组织损伤。
text_en: In contrast, the NaCl combination group accelerated water quality deterioration, increased total dissolved solids (TDS), decreased dissolved oxygen, weakened stress resistance, and led to more severe tissue damage.
outcome: 水质参数、应激抵抗力及组织损伤

quote: Overall, microencapsulation or eugenol co-application were the most effective strategies for enhancing survival and maintaining muscle quality during transportation.
statement: 总体而言，微胶囊化或与丁香酚共同施用是运输期间提高存活率和维持肌肉品质的最有效策略。
text_zh: 总体而言，微胶囊化或与丁香酚共同施用是运输期间提高存活率和维持肌肉品质的最有效策略。
text_en: Overall, microencapsulation or co-administration with eugenol are the most effective strategies for improving survival and maintaining muscle quality during transport.

quote: The superior performance of the eugenol compound group may be attributed to its anesthetic effect, which reduces fish activity, thereby lowering energy metabolism and lactic acid accumulation [ 9 ].
statement: 丁香酚复合组表现优异可能归因于其麻醉作用，该作用通过降低鱼类活动量从而减少能量代谢和乳酸积累。
text_zh: 丁香酚复合组表现优异可能归因于其麻醉作用，该作用通过降低鱼类活动量从而减少能量代谢和乳酸积累。
text_en: The excellent performance of the eugenol compound group may be attributed to its anesthetic effect, which reduces fish activity and thereby decreases energy metabolism and lactic acid accumulation.

quote: The effectiveness of the microcapsule group might be due to the continuous release of active compounds, maintaining a stable antioxidant effect and reducing oxidative damage to muscle cell membranes (Figure 1).
statement: 微胶囊组的有效性可能源于活性化合物的持续释放，从而维持稳定的抗氧化效果并减少肌肉细胞膜的氧化损伤。
text_zh: 微胶囊组的有效性可能源于活性化合物的持续释放，从而维持稳定的抗氧化效果并减少肌肉细胞膜的氧化损伤。
text_en: The effectiveness of the microencapsulation group may stem from the sustained release of active compounds, thereby maintaining stable antioxidant effects and reducing oxidative damage to muscle cell membranes.

quote: This effect may be attributed to the addition of ginger extract, which helps alleviate stress (Figure 4).
statement: 这种颜色变化效应可能归因于添加的姜提取物，它有助于缓解应激。
text_zh: 这种颜色变化效应可能归因于添加的姜提取物，它有助于缓解应激。
text_en: This color change effect may be attributed to the added ginger extract, which helps alleviate stress.

quote: the pH of the water gradually decreased over the course of transportation, shifting from slightly alkaline to slightly acidic.
statement: 在运输过程中，水的pH值逐渐下降，从弱碱性变为弱酸性。
text_zh: 在运输过程中，水的pH值逐渐下降，从弱碱性变为弱酸性。
text_en: During transport, the pH of the water gradually decreased, changing from weakly alkaline to weakly acidic.

quote: This may be attributed to the Cl − ions in the NaCl compound group competing with HCO 3 − , thereby weakening the buffering capacity of bicarbonate [ 26 ].
statement: NaCl复合组中氯离子与碳酸氢根离子的竞争可能削弱了碳酸氢盐的缓冲能力。
text_zh: NaCl复合组中氯离子与碳酸氢根离子的竞争可能削弱了碳酸氢盐的缓冲能力。
text_en: In the NaCl composite group, the competition between chloride ions and bicarbonate ions may have weakened the buffering capacity of bicarbonate.

quote: Furthermore, the salinity stress may increase ammonia and urea excretion as part of disturbed nitrogen metabolism.
statement: 盐度胁迫可能会作为氮代谢紊乱的一部分增加氨和尿素的排泄。
text_zh: 盐度胁迫可能会作为氮代谢紊乱的一部分增加氨和尿素的排泄。
text_en: Salinity stress may increase the excretion of ammonia and urea as part of nitrogen metabolism disorder.
counterevidence: 盐度胁迫加剧代谢废物产生

quote: The conversion of ammonia to ammonium and associated proton release contributes acid equivalents, further lowering pH in the water [ 27 , 28 ].
statement: 氨转化为铵并释放质子会产生酸当量，进一步降低水中的pH值。
text_zh: 氨转化为铵并释放质子会产生酸当量，进一步降低水中的pH值。
text_en: The conversion of ammonia to ammonium releases protons, generating acid equivalents that further lower the pH of the water.

quote: The concentration of ammonia nitrogen in the water showed an increasing trend with the extension of transportation time Figure 3 C.
statement: 水中氨氮浓度随着运输时间的延长呈上升趋势。
text_zh: 水中氨氮浓度随着运输时间的延长呈上升趋势。
text_en: The concentration of ammonia nitrogen in water increased with longer transport time.

quote: The accumulation of ammonia nitrogen in the aquatic environment can exert toxic effects on fish by disrupting physiological homeostasis [ 30 ].
statement: 水生环境中氨氮的积累会通过破坏生理稳态对鱼类产生毒性作用。
text_zh: 水生环境中氨氮的积累会通过破坏生理稳态对鱼类产生毒性作用。
text_en: The accumulation of ammonia nitrogen in aquatic environments exerts toxic effects on fish by disrupting physiological homeostasis.

quote: Elevated ammonia levels may impair gill function, damage liver and muscle tissue structures, and interfere with normal metabolic processes [ 30 , 31 , 32 ].
statement: 升高的氨水平可能会损害鳃功能，损伤肝脏和肌肉组织结构，并干扰正常的代谢过程。
text_zh: 升高的氨水平可能会损害鳃功能，损伤肝脏和肌肉组织结构，并干扰正常的代谢过程。
text_en: Elevated ammonia levels may damage gill function, injure liver and muscle tissue structure, and interfere with normal metabolic processes.
counterevidence: 高氨水平导致组织损伤

quote: These physiological disturbances often trigger a cascade of stress responses, including increased cortisol secretion (Figure 4), oxidative stress (Figure 5), and altered immune f
statement: 这些生理紊乱通常会引发一系列应激反应，包括皮质醇分泌增加、氧化应激和免疫功能改变。
text_zh: 这些生理紊乱通常会引发一系列应激反应，包括皮质醇分泌增加、氧化应激和免疫功能改变。
text_en: These physiological disturbances usually trigger a series of stress responses, including increased cortisol secretion, oxidative stress, and altered immune function.

quote: the microcapsule and eugenol compound groups exhibited the highest survival rates at 72 h of transport, both reaching 50%.
statement: 微胶囊组和丁香酚复合组在运输72小时后表现出最高的存活率，均达到50%。
text_zh: 微胶囊组和丁香酚复合组在运输72小时后表现出最高的存活率，均达到50%。
text_en: The microcapsule group and the eugenol composite group showed the highest survival rates after 72 hours of transport, both reaching 50%.

quote: All groups except the control maintained 100% survival at 36 h.
statement: 除对照组外，所有组在36小时均保持100%的存活率。
text_zh: 除对照组外，所有组在36小时均保持100%的存活率。
text_en: Except for the control group, all groups maintained a 100% survival rate at 36 hours.

quote: Survival rates at 60 h were notably elevated in all treatment groups compared to the control (10%), with the eugenol compound group reaching 90%, followed by the microcapsule (80%), ginger (70%), and NaCl compound (60%) groups.
statement: 与对照组（10%）相比，所有处理组在60小时的存活率均显著升高，其中丁香酚复合组达到90%，其次是微胶囊组（80%）、姜组（70%）和氯化钠复合组（60%）。
text_zh: 与对照组（10%）相比，所有处理组在60小时的存活率均显著升高，其中丁香酚复合组达到90%，其次是微胶囊组（80%）、姜组（70%）和氯化钠复合组（60%）。
text_en: Compared with the control group (10%), survival rates at 60 hours were significantly higher in all treatment groups, reaching 90% in the eugenol compound group, followed by the microcapsule group (80%), ginger group (70%), and sodium chloride compound group (60%).

quote: The addition of eugenol can reduce the metabolic activity rate in fish [ 9 ].
statement: 添加丁香酚可以降低鱼的代谢活动速率。
text_zh: 添加丁香酚可以降低鱼的代谢活动速率。
text_en: Adding eugenol can reduce the metabolic rate of fish.

quote: While NaCl can mitigate stress by enhancing osmoregulatory function [ 9 ], sustained exposure to elevated salinity levels may cause damage to gill tissues.
statement: 虽然氯化钠可以通过增强渗透调节功能来缓解应激，但持续暴露于高盐水平可能会造成鳃组织损伤。
text_zh: 虽然氯化钠可以通过增强渗透调节功能来缓解应激，但持续暴露于高盐水平可能会造成鳃组织损伤。
text_en: Although sodium chloride can alleviate stress by enhancing osmoregulatory function, continuous exposure to high salinity levels may cause gill tissue damage.
outcome: 应激缓解与鳃组织健康
counterevidence: 持续暴露于高盐水平可能会造成鳃组织损伤

quote: Although the osmotic regulation of the NaCl compound group can temporarily alleviate ion imbalance, its metabolic cost partially offsets the anti-stress effect through energy competition, oxidative damage, and other pathways, and the COR inhibitory effect is weak [ 41 ].
statement: 虽然氯化钠复合组的渗透调节可以暂时缓解离子失衡，但其代谢成本通过能量竞争、氧化损伤等途径部分抵消了抗应激效果，且对皮质醇的抑制作用较弱。
text_zh: 虽然氯化钠复合组的渗透调节可以暂时缓解离子失衡，但其代谢成本通过能量竞争、氧化损伤等途径部分抵消了抗应激效果，且对皮质醇的抑制作用较弱。
text_en: Although the osmoregulation of the sodium chloride combination group can temporarily alleviate ion imbalance, its metabolic cost partially offsets the anti-stress effect through pathways such as energy competition and oxidative damage, and its inhibitory effect on cortisol is weak.
counterevidence: 抗应激效果被代谢成本部分抵消

quote: the concentrations of UREA and CREA (creatinine) show an upward trend with the prolongation of transportation time.
statement: 随着运输时间的延长，尿素氮和肌酐浓度呈上升趋势。
text_zh: 随着运输时间的延长，尿素氮和肌酐浓度呈上升趋势。
text_en: As transport time increases, urea nitrogen and creatinine concentrations show an upward trend.

quote: At 48 h, the concentration of UREA in the control group, ginger group, and eugenol compound group was significantly higher than that in the microcapsule group and NaCl compound group
statement: 在48小时时，对照组、姜组和丁香酚复合组的尿素氮浓度显著高于微胶囊组和氯化钠复合组。
text_zh: 在48小时时，对照组、姜组和丁香酚复合组的尿素氮浓度显著高于微胶囊组和氯化钠复合组。
text_en: At 48 hours, the urea nitrogen concentrations in the control group, ginger group, and eugenol composite group were significantly higher than those in the microcapsule group and sodium chloride composite group.

quote: However, long-term exposure to high salinity can induce a decrease in glomerular filtration rate, leading to the accumulation of CREA.
statement: 长期暴露于高盐度环境可诱导肾小球滤过率下降，导致肌酐积累。
text_zh: 长期暴露于高盐度环境可诱导肾小球滤过率下降，导致肌酐积累。
text_en: Long-term exposure to a high-salinity environment can induce a decrease in glomerular filtration rate, leading to creatinine accumulation.

quote: the concentration of AST (aspartate aminotransferase) increases with the prolongation of transport time, reflecting an increase in membrane permeability of liver cells.
statement: 随着运输时间的延长，天冬氨酸氨基转移酶浓度增加，反映了肝细胞膜通透性的增加。
text_zh: 随着运输时间的延长，天冬氨酸氨基转移酶浓度增加，反映了肝细胞膜通透性的增加。
text_en: As transport time increases, aspartate aminotransferase concentration increases, reflecting an increase in hepatocyte membrane permeability.

quote: At 48 h, the AST concentration in the control group reached 875.65 U/L, while the ginger group (623.8 U/L) showed the best performance in the treatment group, followed by the Microcapsule group (778.28 U/L), NaCl compound group (821.32 U/L), and eugenol compound group (847.14 U/L).
statement: 在48小时时，对照组的AST浓度为875.65 U/L，而姜组（623.8 U/L）在处理组中表现最佳，其次是微胶囊组、氯化钠复合组和丁香酚复合组。
text_zh: 在48小时时，对照组的AST浓度为875.65 U/L，而姜组（623.8 U/L）在处理组中表现最佳，其次是微胶囊组、氯化钠复合组和丁香酚复合组。
text_en: At 48 hours, the AST concentration in the control group was 875.65 U/L, while the ginger group (623.8 U/L) performed best among the treatment groups, followed by the microencapsulated group, the sodium chloride composite group, and the eugenol composite group.

quote: ginger extract achieves efficient protection through multi-target anti-inflammatory antioxidant mechanisms.
statement: 姜提取物通过多靶点抗炎抗氧化机制实现高效保护。
text_zh: 姜提取物通过多靶点抗炎抗氧化机制实现高效保护。
text_en: Ginger extract achieves efficient protection through a multi-target anti-inflammatory and antioxidant mechanism.

quote: Osmotic regulation and anesthesia strategies may exacerbate liver load due to metabolic compensatory effects
statement: 渗透调节和麻醉策略可能因代谢补偿效应而加剧肝脏负担。
text_zh: 渗透调节和麻醉策略可能因代谢补偿效应而加剧肝脏负担。
text_en: Osmoregulation and anaesthesia strategies may exacerbate liver burden due to metabolic compensation effects.

quote: the activities of SOD (superoxide dismutase) and GPX (glutathione peroxidase) showed a decreasing trend with the prolongation of transport time;
statement: 随着运输时间的延长，超氧化物歧化酶和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶的活性呈下降趋势。
text_zh: 随着运输时间的延长，超氧化物歧化酶和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶的活性呈下降趋势。
text_en: As transport time increases, the activity of superoxide dismutase and glutathione peroxidase shows a downward trend.

quote: The CHOL (cholesterol) concentration of the control group and the eugenol compound group (Figure 4 B) showed an increasing trend with the prolongation of transportation time.
statement: 对照组和丁香酚复合物组的CHOL（胆固醇）浓度随着运输时间的延长呈上升趋势。
text_zh: 对照组和丁香酚复合物组的CHOL（胆固醇）浓度随着运输时间的延长呈上升趋势。
text_en: The CHOL (cholesterol) concentrations in the control group and the eugenol compound group showed an upward trend with increasing transport time.

quote: The ginger group and NaCl compound group showed an initial decrease followed by a increase trend.
statement: 姜组和氯化钠复合组的该指标呈现先下降后上升的趋势。
text_zh: 姜组和氯化钠复合组的该指标呈现先下降后上升的趋势。
text_en: The indicator for the ginger group and the sodium chloride composite group showed a trend of first decreasing and then increasing.

quote: The TG concentration (Figure 4 C) showed a decreasing trend with the prolongation of transportation time.
statement: 甘油三酯（TG）浓度随运输时间延长呈下降趋势。
text_zh: 甘油三酯（TG）浓度随运输时间延长呈下降趋势。
text_en: Triglyceride (TG) concentration showed a decreasing trend with longer transport time.

quote: The concentration of GLU (Figure 4 D) shows an upward trend with the prolongation of transportation time.
statement: 葡萄糖（GLU）浓度随运输时间延长呈上升趋势。
text_zh: 葡萄糖（GLU）浓度随运输时间延长呈上升趋势。
text_en: Glucose (GLU) concentration showed an upward trend with increasing transport time.

quote: After transportation for 48 h, the CHOL and GLU concentrations in the control group and eugenol compound group were significantly higher than those in the ginger group, microcapsule group, and NaCl compound group (p
statement: 运输48小时后，对照组和丁香酚复合组的胆固醇（CHOL）和葡萄糖（GLU）浓度显著高于姜组、微胶囊组和氯化钠复合组。
text_zh: 运输48小时后，对照组和丁香酚复合组的胆固醇（CHOL）和葡萄糖（GLU）浓度显著高于姜组、微胶囊组和氯化钠复合组。
text_en: After 48 hours of transport, the cholesterol (CHOL) and glucose (GLU) concentrations in the control group and the eugenol composite group were significantly higher than those in the ginger group, the microcapsule group, and the NaCl composite group.

quote: At the same time, its anesthetic effect inhibits insulin secretion, leading to impaired glucose utilization and resulting in blood glucose accumulation [ 40 ].
statement: 其麻醉作用抑制胰岛素分泌，导致葡萄糖利用受损并引起血糖积累。
text_zh: 其麻醉作用抑制胰岛素分泌，导致葡萄糖利用受损并引起血糖积累。
text_en: Its anesthetic effect inhibits insulin secretion, leading to impaired glucose utilization and causing blood glucose accumulation.

quote: From Figure 4 E, it can be seen that there is a decrease in serum COR (cortisol) concentration during transportation.
statement: 血清皮质醇（COR）浓度在运输期间下降。
text_zh: 血清皮质醇（COR）浓度在运输期间下降。
text_en: Serum cortisol (COR) concentration decreased during transport.

quote: Furthermore, the content of COR was lowest in microcapsule group compared with other groups after transportation for 48 h.
statement: 运输48小时后，与其他组相比，微胶囊组的皮质醇含量最低。
text_zh: 运输48小时后，与其他组相比，微胶囊组的皮质醇含量最低。
text_en: After 48 hours of transport, the microcapsule group had the lowest cortisol content compared to other groups.

quote: This may be attributed to gingerol inhibiting the NF-κB inflammatory pathway [ 17 ], resulting in a 22.2% decrease in COR production compared to the control group.
statement: 这可能归因于姜辣素抑制NF-κB炎症通路，导致皮质醇产生比对照组减少22.2%。
text_zh: 这可能归因于姜辣素抑制NF-κB炎症通路，导致皮质醇产生比对照组减少22.2%。
text_en: This may be attributed to gingerol inhibiting the NF-κB inflammatory pathway, resulting in a 22.2% reduction in cortisol production compared to the control group.

quote: The anesthetic effect of the compound group of eugenol has been attenuated at 48 h, but the early metabolic inhibition reduces the stress accumulation effect and lowers COR secretion;
statement: 丁香酚复合组的麻醉效应在48小时时减弱，但早期的代谢抑制减少了应激累积效应并降低了皮质醇分泌。
text_zh: 丁香酚复合组的麻醉效应在48小时时减弱，但早期的代谢抑制减少了应激累积效应并降低了皮质醇分泌。
text_en: The anesthetic effect of the eugenol combination group weakened at 48 hours, but early metabolic suppression reduced the cumulative stress effect and decreased cortisol secretion.

quote: After 48 h of transportation, the SOD and GPX activities in the control group were significantly lower than those in the microcapsule group and NaCl compound group
statement: 运输48小时后，对照组的SOD和GPX活性显著低于微胶囊组和NaCl复合组。
text_zh: 运输48小时后，对照组的SOD和GPX活性显著低于微胶囊组和NaCl复合组。
text_en: After 48 hours of transport, the SOD and GPX activities in the control group were significantly lower than those in the microcapsule group and the NaCl composite group.

quote: The MDA content in the compound group of eugenol was higher than the other four groups.
statement: 丁香酚复合组的MDA含量高于其他四组。
text_zh: 丁香酚复合组的MDA含量高于其他四组。
text_en: The MDA content in the eugenol compound group was higher than that in the other four groups.

quote: The SOD and GPX activities were higher in the ginger group, microcapsule group, and NaCl compound group, indicating that ginger extract can improve the antioxidant capacity of fish and effectively cope with environmental stress.
statement: 生姜组、微胶囊组和NaCl复合组的SOD和GPX活性较高，表明生姜提取物可以提高鱼的抗氧化能力并有效应对环境胁迫。
text_zh: 生姜组、微胶囊组和NaCl复合组的SOD和GPX活性较高，表明生姜提取物可以提高鱼的抗氧化能力并有效应对环境胁迫。
text_en: The SOD and GPX activities were higher in the ginger group, the microcapsule group, and the NaCl composite group, indicating that ginger extract can improve the antioxidant capacity of fish and effectively cope with environmental stress.
outcome: 抗氧化能力与环境胁迫应对

quote: The NaCl compound group may indirectly reduce GPX consumption by stabilizing gill ion transport function, reducing ROS bursts caused by mitochondrial calcium overload
statement: NaCl复合组可能通过稳定鳃离子转运功能，减少由线粒体钙超载引起的ROS爆发，从而间接降低GPX消耗。
text_zh: NaCl复合组可能通过稳定鳃离子转运功能，减少由线粒体钙超载引起的ROS爆发，从而间接降低GPX消耗。
text_en: The NaCl composite group may indirectly reduce GPX consumption by stabilizing gill ion transport function and reducing the ROS burst caused by mitochondrial calcium overload.

quote: The MDA content in the compound group of eugenol is higher, possibly due to the anesthetic effect of eugenol, which inhibits the activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain complex I, increases electron leakage
statement: 丁香酚复合组MDA含量较高，可能是由于丁香酚的麻醉作用抑制了线粒体呼吸链复合物I的活性，增加了电子泄漏。
text_zh: 丁香酚复合组MDA含量较高，可能是由于丁香酚的麻醉作用抑制了线粒体呼吸链复合物I的活性，增加了电子泄漏。
text_en: The eugenol combination group had higher MDA content, possibly because the anesthetic effect of eugenol inhibited the activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain complex I, increasing electron leakage.
outcome: 线粒体功能与氧化损伤

quote: and inhibits GSH synthesis, leading to impaired GPX function and weakened H 2 O 2 clearance ability, forming a vicious cycle of free radical accumulation membrane damage
statement: 并抑制GSH合成，导致GPX功能受损和H2O2清除能力减弱，形成自由基积累和膜损伤的恶性循环。
text_zh: 并抑制GSH合成，导致GPX功能受损和H2O2清除能力减弱，形成自由基积累和膜损伤的恶性循环。
text_en: and inhibits GSH synthesis, leading to impaired GPX function and reduced H2O2 scavenging capacity, forming a vicious cycle of free radical accumulation and membrane damage.

quote: the transcription levels of hsp70 and hsp90 showed an upward trend with prolonged transport time.
statement: 热休克蛋白hsp70和hsp90的转录水平随运输时间延长呈上升趋势。
text_zh: 热休克蛋白hsp70和hsp90的转录水平随运输时间延长呈上升趋势。
text_en: The transcription levels of heat shock proteins hsp70 and hsp90 showed an upward trend with prolonged transport time.

quote: The relative expression levels of hsp70 and hsp90 in the control group were significantly higher than those in the treatment group at 24 and 48 h
statement: 在24小时和48小时时，对照组中hsp70和hsp90的相对表达水平显著高于处理组。
text_zh: 在24小时和48小时时，对照组中hsp70和hsp90的相对表达水平显著高于处理组。
text_en: At 24 and 48 hours, the relative expression levels of hsp70 and hsp90 in the control group were significantly higher than those in the treatment groups.

quote: Our previous unpublished results indicated that a concentration of 0.1 mg/mL ginger extract was most effective in reducing oxidative stress and preserving muscle quality.
statement: 先前的未发表结果表明，0.1 mg/mL的姜提取物浓度在减少氧化应激和保持肌肉品质方面最有效。
text_zh: 先前的未发表结果表明，0.1 mg/mL的姜提取物浓度在减少氧化应激和保持肌肉品质方面最有效。
text_en: Previous unpublished results indicated that a ginger extract concentration of 0.1 mg/mL was most effective in reducing oxidative stress and maintaining muscle quality.

quote: The fish-to-water ratio was maintained at 1:3, using aerated tap water as the water source.
statement: 鱼水比维持在1:3，使用充气的自来水作为水源。
text_zh: 鱼水比维持在1:3，使用充气的自来水作为水源。
text_en: The fish-to-water ratio was maintained at 1:3, using aerated tap water as the water source.

quote: Then put it into a foam incubator (290 × 170 × 190 mm), add an ice bag of 50% of the total weight of fish and water, and place it on a simulated transport platform for simulated transport.
statement: 将袋子放入泡沫培养箱中，加入相当于鱼和水总重量50%的冰袋，并放置在模拟运输平台上进行模拟运输。
text_zh: 将袋子放入泡沫培养箱中，加入相当于鱼和水总重量50%的冰袋，并放置在模拟运输平台上进行模拟运输。
text_en: Place the bag into a foam incubator, add ice packs equivalent to 50% of the total weight of fish and water, and place it on a simulated transport platform for simulated transport.
intervention: Ice pack cooling and simulated transport platform
intervention_record: 冰袋降温与模拟运输平台

quote: The enhanced anti-apoptotic effect observed in the eugenol compound group may be attributed to the combined action of anesthetic properties and the mitochondrial protective effects of ginger extract, forming a dual regulatory barrier that blocks apoptotic signal transduction [ 55 ].
statement: 丁香酚化合物组中观察到的增强抗凋亡效果可能归因于麻醉特性与生姜提取物线粒体保护作用的结合，形成阻断凋亡信号转导的双重调节屏障。
text_zh: 丁香酚化合物组中观察到的增强抗凋亡效果可能归因于麻醉特性与生姜提取物线粒体保护作用的结合，形成阻断凋亡信号转导的双重调节屏障。
text_en: The enhanced anti-apoptotic effect observed in the eugenol compound group may be attributed to the combination of anesthetic properties and the mitochondrial protective effect of ginger extract, forming a dual regulatory barrier that blocks apoptotic signal transduction.

quote: Furthermore, Ginger extract can exert continuous antioxidant protection and modulate apoptosis by activating the Nrf2 signaling pathway, thereby downregulating the pro-apoptotic gene bax and upregulating the anti-apoptotic gene bcl-2 .
statement: 此外，生姜提取物可以通过激活Nrf2信号通路发挥持续抗氧化保护并调节细胞凋亡，从而下调促凋亡基因bax并上调抗凋亡基因bcl-2。
text_zh: 此外，生姜提取物可以通过激活Nrf2信号通路发挥持续抗氧化保护并调节细胞凋亡，从而下调促凋亡基因bax并上调抗凋亡基因bcl-2。
text_en: In addition, ginger extract can exert sustained antioxidant protection and regulate apoptosis by activating the Nrf2 signaling pathway, thereby downregulating the pro-apoptotic gene bax and upregulating the anti-apoptotic gene bcl-2.

quote: This mechanism effectively reduces oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis [ 49 ].
statement: 该机制有效减少氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 该机制有效减少氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。
text_en: This mechanism effectively reduces oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis.
outcome: 氧化应激、炎症与细胞凋亡

quote: This may be due to the anesthetic effect of eugenol, which reduces the frequency of convulsive muscle contractions, thereby minimizing mechanical damage to muscle fibers.
statement: 这归因于丁香酚的麻醉作用，它减少了痉挛性肌肉收缩的频率，从而最大限度地减少了对肌纤维的机械损伤。
text_zh: 这归因于丁香酚的麻醉作用，它减少了痉挛性肌肉收缩的频率，从而最大限度地减少了对肌纤维的机械损伤。
text_en: This is attributed to the anesthetic effect of eugenol, which reduced the frequency of spasmodic muscle contractions, thereby minimizing mechanical damage to muscle fibers.
outcome: 肌肉机械损伤/应激反应

quote: In addition, the synergistic action of ginger extract helps mitigate oxidative stress and inhibits the NF-κB mediated release of inflammatory cytokines, ultimately alleviating the damage of muscle [ 49 ].
statement: 生姜提取物的协同作用有助于减轻氧化应激并抑制NF-κB介导的炎症细胞因子释放，最终缓解肌肉损伤。
text_zh: 生姜提取物的协同作用有助于减轻氧化应激并抑制NF-κB介导的炎症细胞因子释放，最终缓解肌肉损伤。
text_en: The synergistic effect of ginger extract helps to alleviate oxidative stress and inhibit the release of NF-κB-mediated inflammatory cytokines, ultimately relieving muscle damage.

quote: This may be attributed to the anesthetic effects significantly reducing fish activity levels, thereby minimizing damage to muscle fibers [ 50 ].
statement: 这可能归因于麻醉效果显著降低了鱼的活动水平，从而最大限度地减少了肌纤维的损伤。
text_zh: 这可能归因于麻醉效果显著降低了鱼的活动水平，从而最大限度地减少了肌纤维的损伤。
text_en: This may be attributed to the anesthetic effect significantly reducing fish activity levels, thereby minimizing muscle fiber damage.

quote: Additionally, the suppression of glycolysis may have delayed the degradation of myofibrillar proteins, helping to preserve muscle structural integrity [ 50 ].
statement: 此外，对糖酵解的抑制可能延缓了肌原纤维蛋白的降解，有助于保持肌肉结构的完整性。
text_zh: 此外，对糖酵解的抑制可能延缓了肌原纤维蛋白的降解，有助于保持肌肉结构的完整性。
text_en: In addition, the inhibition of glycolysis may have delayed the degradation of myofibrillar proteins, helping to maintain the integrity of muscle structure.

quote: This indicates that the combination of eugenol fish ginger extract may further optimize the anti-stress effect to a certain extent.
statement: 这表明丁香酚与生姜提取物的组合可能在一定程度上进一步优化了抗应激效果。
text_zh: 这表明丁香酚与生姜提取物的组合可能在一定程度上进一步优化了抗应激效果。
text_en: This indicates that the combination of eugenol and ginger extract may have further optimized the anti-stress effect to some extent.
intervention_record: 姜提取物与丁香酚组合

quote: As shown in Figure 9 B, the drip loss of muscle increased with the extension of transportation time.
statement: 如图9B所示，随着运输时间的延长，肌肉滴水损失增加。
text_zh: 如图9B所示，随着运输时间的延长，肌肉滴水损失增加。
text_en: As shown in Figure 9B, muscle drip loss increased with the extension of transport time.

quote: After 48 h of transportation, the eugenol compound group exhibited the lowest drip loss (3.65%), followed by the microcapsule group (4.45%), NaCl combination group (4.46%), ginger extract group (5.44%), and the control group (6.04%).
statement: 经过48小时的运输后，丁香酚复合组的滴水损失最低（3.65%），其次是微胶囊组（4.45%）、NaCl复合组（4.46%）、生姜提取物组（5.44%）和对照组（6.04%）。
text_zh: 经过48小时的运输后，丁香酚复合组的滴水损失最低（3.65%），其次是微胶囊组（4.45%）、NaCl复合组（4.46%）、生姜提取物组（5.44%）和对照组（6.04%）。
text_en: After 48 hours of transport, the eugenol compound group had the lowest drip loss (3.65%), followed by the microcapsule group (4.45%), the NaCl compound group (4.46%), the ginger extract group (5.44%), and the control group (6.04%).

quote: In the ginger group, the direct addition of ginger extract to the water likely led to its rapid degradation, resulting in weakened antioxidant protection during the later stages of transportation (>24 h)
statement: 在姜组中，直接向水中添加姜提取物可能导致其快速降解，从而在运输后期（>24小时）减弱了抗氧化保护。
text_zh: 在姜组中，直接向水中添加姜提取物可能导致其快速降解，从而在运输后期（>24小时）减弱了抗氧化保护。
text_en: In the ginger group, directly adding ginger extract to the water may lead to its rapid degradation, thereby weakening antioxidant protection in the later stages of transport (>24 hours).
intervention: Ginger extract added directly to water
intervention_record: 姜提取物直接加入水中

quote: This decline may have contributed to a rebound in the inflammatory cytokine IL-6 levels, causing local blood sinus dilation and widened intercellular spaces in gill epithelial cells.
statement: 抗氧化保护的减弱可能导致炎症细胞因子IL-6水平反弹，引起鳃上皮细胞局部血窦扩张和细胞间隙增宽。
text_zh: 抗氧化保护的减弱可能导致炎症细胞因子IL-6水平反弹，引起鳃上皮细胞局部血窦扩张和细胞间隙增宽。
text_en: Weakened antioxidant protection may lead to a rebound in IL-6 inflammatory cytokine levels, causing local sinusoidal dilation and widened intercellular spaces in gill epithelial cells.
intervention: Ginger extract added directly to water
intervention_record: 姜提取物直接加入水中

quote: In the NaCl compound group, prolonged exposure to a high-salinity environment may have increased the osmotic burden on gill and liver tissues, ultimately exacerbating structural damage
statement: 在NaCl复合组中，长时间暴露于高盐环境可能增加了鳃和肝脏组织的渗透负担，最终加剧了结构损伤。
text_zh: 在NaCl复合组中，长时间暴露于高盐环境可能增加了鳃和肝脏组织的渗透负担，最终加剧了结构损伤。
text_en: In the NaCl composite group, prolonged exposure to a high-salt environment may have increased the osmotic burden on gill and liver tissues, ultimately exacerbating structural damage.

quote: The control group and the NaCl compound group exhibited similar results, both showing noticeable muscle cell fragmentation and enlarged intercellular spaces
statement: 对照组和NaCl复合组表现出相似的结果，均显示出明显的肌肉细胞破碎和细胞间隙增大。
text_zh: 对照组和NaCl复合组表现出相似的结果，均显示出明显的肌肉细胞破碎和细胞间隙增大。
text_en: The control group and the NaCl composite group showed similar results, both exhibiting obvious muscle cell fragmentation and increased intercellular spaces.

quote: Prolonged transportation negatively impacts fish survival, physiology, and muscle quality.
statement: 长时间的运输对鱼类的存活率、生理状况和肌肉品质有负面影响。
text_zh: 长时间的运输对鱼类的存活率、生理状况和肌肉品质有负面影响。
text_en: Long-duration transport has negative effects on fish survival rate, physiological status, and muscle quality.
outcome: 存活率、生理状况、肌肉品质

quote: eugenol compound group exhibited significantly higher glycogen levels compared to the other groups.
statement: 丁香酚复合组与其他组相比表现出显著更高的糖原水平。
text_zh: 丁香酚复合组与其他组相比表现出显著更高的糖原水平。
text_en: The eugenol combination group showed significantly higher glycogen levels compared to the other groups.

quote: However, by 48 h, its glycogen content dropped sharply to 1.18 mg/g, which was significantly lower than that of the NaCl compound group (1.45 mg/g).
statement: 然而，到48小时时，其糖原含量急剧下降至1.18 mg/g，显著低于NaCl复合组（1.45 mg/g）。
text_zh: 然而，到48小时时，其糖原含量急剧下降至1.18 mg/g，显著低于NaCl复合组（1.45 mg/g）。
text_en: However, by 48 hours, its glycogen content dropped sharply to 1.18 mg/g, significantly lower than the NaCl composite group (1.45 mg/g).
counterevidence: 与NaCl复合组相比表现较差

quote: A significant increase in lactate content was observed as the transportation time extended from 0 to 48 h, with the control group exhibiting the highest accumulation, reaching 51.49 μmol/g (Figure 10 B).
statement: 随着运输时间从0延长到48小时，观察到乳酸含量显著增加，其中对照组的积累最高，达到51.49 μmol/g。
text_zh: 随着运输时间从0延长到48小时，观察到乳酸含量显著增加，其中对照组的积累最高，达到51.49 μmol/g。
text_en: As transport time increased from 0 to 48 hours, a significant increase in lactate content was observed, with the highest accumulation in the control group reaching 51.49 μmol/g.

quote: Correspondingly, the pH level in fish muscle decreased significantly (Figure 10 C).
statement: 相应地，鱼肌肉中的pH值显著降低。
text_zh: 相应地，鱼肌肉中的pH值显著降低。
text_en: Accordingly, the pH in fish muscle decreased significantly.

quote: These results indicate that the microcapsule group and the eugenol compound group were most effective in controlling lactate accumulation during transportation, thereby alleviating stress responses and helping to maintain acid–base balance in the muscle.
statement: 这些结果表明，微胶囊组和丁香酚复合组在控制运输过程中的乳酸积累方面最有效，从而减轻应激反应并有助于维持肌肉中的酸碱平衡。
text_zh: 这些结果表明，微胶囊组和丁香酚复合组在控制运输过程中的乳酸积累方面最有效，从而减轻应激反应并有助于维持肌肉中的酸碱平衡。
text_en: These results indicate that the microcapsule group and the eugenol composite group were most effective in controlling lactic acid accumulation during transport, thereby reducing stress responses and helping to maintain acid-base balance in the muscle.

quote: According to Table 2 , the ATP content shows a trend of first increasing and then decreasing with the extension of transport time, while the ADP content continues to decrease.
statement: 根据表2，ATP含量随运输时间的延长呈现先升后降的趋势，而ADP含量持续下降。
text_zh: 根据表2，ATP含量随运输时间的延长呈现先升后降的趋势，而ADP含量持续下降。
text_en: According to Table 2, ATP content showed a trend of first increasing and then decreasing with the extension of transport time, while ADP content continuously decreased.

quote: At 48 h, the ATP content of the eugenol compound group (5.58 mg/100 g) was significantly higher than that of the other groups, which may be due to its anesthetic effect, reducing energy consumption and inhibiting ATPase activity, delaying ATP degradation [ 52 ].
statement: 在48小时时，丁香酚复合组的ATP含量（5.58 mg/100 g）显著高于其他组，这可能是由于其麻醉作用减少了能量消耗并抑制了ATP酶活性，从而延缓了ATP降解。
text_zh: 在48小时时，丁香酚复合组的ATP含量（5.58 mg/100 g）显著高于其他组，这可能是由于其麻醉作用减少了能量消耗并抑制了ATP酶活性，从而延缓了ATP降解。
text_en: At 48 hours, the ATP content of the eugenol compound group (5.58 mg/100 g) was significantly higher than that of other groups; this may be because its anesthetic effect reduced energy consumption and inhibited ATPase activity, thereby delaying ATP degradation.

quote: The AMP content in the eugenol compound group first decreased and then increased, reaching a maximum value of 6.13 mg/100 g at 48 h, significantly higher than other groups (p 53 ].
statement: 丁香酚复合组的AMP含量先降后升，在48小时达到最大值6.13 mg/100 g，显著高于其他组。
text_zh: 丁香酚复合组的AMP含量先降后升，在48小时达到最大值6.13 mg/100 g，显著高于其他组。
text_en: The AMP content in the eugenol composite group first decreased and then increased, reaching a maximum of 6.13 mg/100 g at 48 hours, which was significantly higher than that of the other groups.
counterevidence: AMP升高通常指示能量耗竭或应激

quote: The transcription levels of pro-apoptotic genes caspase 3 , caspase 8 , caspase 9 and bax showed an increasing trend with prolonged transportation time, whereas the transcription level of the anti-apoptotic gene bcl-2 gradually decreased over time.
statement: 随着运输时间的延长，促凋亡基因（caspase 3、caspase 8、caspase 9和bax）的转录水平呈上升趋势，而抗凋亡基因（bcl-2）的转录水平随时间逐渐下降。
text_zh: 随着运输时间的延长，促凋亡基因（caspase 3、caspase 8、caspase 9和bax）的转录水平呈上升趋势，而抗凋亡基因（bcl-2）的转录水平随时间逐渐下降。
text_en: As transport time increased, the transcription levels of pro-apoptotic genes (caspase 3, caspase 8, caspase 9 and bax) showed an upward trend, while the transcription level of the anti-apoptotic gene (bcl-2) gradually decreased over time.

quote: These results indicate that transportation induces the activation of apoptotic pathways in fish, likely as a physiological response to prolonged stress [ 4 , 54 ].
statement: 结果表明运输诱导鱼类激活凋亡通路，这可能是对长时间应激的生理反应。
text_zh: 结果表明运输诱导鱼类激活凋亡通路，这可能是对长时间应激的生理反应。
text_en: The results indicate that transport induces the activation of apoptosis pathways in fish, which may be a physiological response to prolonged stress.

quote: At 24 h, the ginger group and eugenol compound group exhibited the lowest relative expression levels of caspase 3 (p caspase 8 expression level (p caspase 3 and caspase 9 at this time point, with the sustained-release group ranking second.
statement: 在24小时时，姜组和丁香酚复合组表现出最低的caspase 3相对表达水平，缓释组排名第二。
text_zh: 在24小时时，姜组和丁香酚复合组表现出最低的caspase 3相对表达水平，缓释组排名第二。
text_en: At 24 hours, the ginger group and the eugenol composite group showed the lowest relative expression levels of caspase 3, with the sustained-release group ranking second.
intervention_record: 姜提取物与丁香酚组合

quote: These results indicate that the eugenol compound group and the microcapsule group exhibited a more pronounced inhibitory effect on apoptosis, whereas the NaCl compound group and the ginger group were relatively less effective.
statement: 这些结果表明，丁香酚复合组和微胶囊组对细胞凋亡表现出更明显的抑制作用，而NaCl复合组和姜组的效果相对较差。
text_zh: 这些结果表明，丁香酚复合组和微胶囊组对细胞凋亡表现出更明显的抑制作用，而NaCl复合组和姜组的效果相对较差。
text_en: These results indicate that the eugenol composite group and the microcapsule group showed a more pronounced inhibitory effect on apoptosis, while the effects of the NaCl composite group and the ginger group were relatively poorer.
counterevidence: NaCl复合组和姜组效果相对较差

quote: 3.11. Determination of mRNA Relative Expression of hsp70, hsp90, caspase3, and il-6 in Blood
statement: 研究通过测定血液中hsp70、hsp90、caspase3和il-6的mRNA相对表达量来评估相关指标。
text_zh: 研究通过测定血液中hsp70、hsp90、caspase3和il-6的mRNA相对表达量来评估相关指标。
text_en: The study assessed relevant indicators by measuring the relative mRNA expression levels of hsp70, hsp90, caspase3, and il-6 in blood.

quote: The lesions only occurred in adult allogynogenetic crucian carp, even though they were cultured together with other fish species.
statement: 病变仅发生在成年异育银鲫中，尽管它们与其他鱼类混养。
text_zh: 病变仅发生在成年异育银鲫中，尽管它们与其他鱼类混养。
text_en: Lesions occurred only in adult allogynogenetic gibel carp, although they were co-cultured with other fish species.

quote: There was marked variation in incidence: in some ponds, only a few fish were affected, while the incidence was up to 90% in other ponds.
statement: 发病率存在显著差异：一些池塘只有少数鱼受影响，而其他池塘的发病率高达90%。
text_zh: 发病率存在显著差异：一些池塘只有少数鱼受影响，而其他池塘的发病率高达90%。
text_en: There is a significant difference in morbidity: some ponds had only a few fish affected, while the morbidity rate in other ponds reached as high as 90%.

quote: All treatment groups alleviated gill and liver damage to varying degrees.
statement: 所有处理组都在不同程度上减轻了鳃和肝脏的损伤。
text_zh: 所有处理组都在不同程度上减轻了鳃和肝脏的损伤。
text_en: All treatment groups reduced gill and liver damage to varying degrees.

quote: Among them, the microcapsule group and the eugenol compound group showed more pronounced protective effects.
statement: 其中，微胶囊组和丁香酚复合物组显示出更明显的保护效果。
text_zh: 其中，微胶囊组和丁香酚复合物组显示出更明显的保护效果。
text_en: Among them, the microcapsule group and the eugenol complex group showed more obvious protective effects.

quote: In these two groups, the gill filaments were neatly arranged, with only mild bending observed in a few filaments.
statement: 在这两组中，鳃丝排列整齐，仅观察到少数鳃丝轻微弯曲。
text_zh: 在这两组中，鳃丝排列整齐，仅观察到少数鳃丝轻微弯曲。
text_en: In both groups, the gill filaments were neatly arranged, with only a few slight bends observed.

quote: Hepatocytes maintained relatively intact structures with clearer nuclei.
statement: 肝细胞保持了相对完整的结构，且细胞核更清晰。
text_zh: 肝细胞保持了相对完整的结构，且细胞核更清晰。
text_en: Hepatocytes maintained a relatively intact structure, and the cell nuclei were clearer.

quote: In contrast, the ginger group and the NaCl compound group showed moderate damage.
statement: 相比之下，姜组和NaCl复合物组表现出中等程度的损伤。
text_zh: 相比之下，姜组和NaCl复合物组表现出中等程度的损伤。
text_en: In contrast, the ginger group and the NaCl complex group showed moderate damage.

quote: Most gill filaments were bent but still relatively well-aligned.
statement: 大多数鳃丝弯曲但仍相对排列良好。
text_zh: 大多数鳃丝弯曲但仍相对排列良好。
text_en: Most gill filaments were curved but still relatively well arranged.

quote: Dilated blood vessels, swollen mucus cells, and more severe chloride cell proliferation and vacuolization were observed compared to the microcapsule group.
statement: 与微胶囊组相比，观察到血管扩张、粘液细胞肿胀以及更严重的氯细胞增殖和空泡化。
text_zh: 与微胶囊组相比，观察到血管扩张、粘液细胞肿胀以及更严重的氯细胞增殖和空泡化。
text_en: Compared to the microcapsule group, vasodilation, swelling of mucus cells, and more severe proliferation and vacuolization of chloride cells were observed.

quote: The gill and liver tissues in the microcapsule group and the eugenol compound group exhibited the most intact and well-defined structures, indicating a more effective alleviation of oxidative stress and enhanced protection of tissue integrity.
statement: 微胶囊组和丁香酚复合物组的鳃和肝组织表现出最完整和清晰的结构，表明其更有效地缓解了氧化应激并增强了对组织完整性的保护。
text_zh: 微胶囊组和丁香酚复合物组的鳃和肝组织表现出最完整和清晰的结构，表明其更有效地缓解了氧化应激并增强了对组织完整性的保护。
text_en: The microcapsule group and the eugenol complex group showed the most complete and clear structures in gill and liver tissues, indicating that they more effectively alleviated oxidative stress and enhanced protection of tissue integrity.
outcome: 氧化应激缓解/组织保护

quote: The more severe structural damage observed in the gill and liver tissues of the ginger extract group and the NaCl compound group may be attributed to different underlying factors.
statement: 姜提取物组和NaCl复合物组鳃和肝组织中观察到的更严重的结构损伤可能归因于不同的潜在因素。
text_zh: 姜提取物组和NaCl复合物组鳃和肝组织中观察到的更严重的结构损伤可能归因于不同的潜在因素。
text_en: The more severe structural damage observed in the gill and liver tissues of the ginger extract group and the NaCl complex group may be attributed to different underlying factors.

quote: water quality parameters, blood stress parameters and muscle quality were taken at fixed intervals of 24 h to detect changes in water indicators, physiological and biochemical indicators, and muscle quality.
statement: 水质参数、血液应激参数和肌肉质量每24小时采集一次，以检测水质指标、生理生化指标和肌肉质量的变化。
text_zh: 水质参数、血液应激参数和肌肉质量每24小时采集一次，以检测水质指标、生理生化指标和肌肉质量的变化。
text_en: Water quality parameters, blood stress parameters, and muscle quality were collected every 24 hours to detect changes in water quality indicators, physiological and biochemical indicators, and muscle quality.
outcome: 水质与生理生化指标变化

quote: After complete loss of breath, crucian carp can be considered dead [ 60 ], characterized by floating heads, overturned bellies, and other features.
statement: 鲫鱼完全停止呼吸后可被视为死亡，特征为头浮起、腹部翻转等。
text_zh: 鲫鱼完全停止呼吸后可被视为死亡，特征为头浮起、腹部翻转等。
text_en: Crucian carp can be considered dead after respiration has completely stopped, characterized by the head floating up and the abdomen turning over.

quote: The statistical time points are at 0, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, and 72 h after the start of preservation, and the number of fish in each group still alive at each time point will be counted.
statement: 统计时间点为保鲜开始后0、12、24、36、48、60和72小时，并计数每组在每个时间点仍存活的鱼的数量。
text_zh: 统计时间点为保鲜开始后0、12、24、36、48、60和72小时，并计数每组在每个时间点仍存活的鱼的数量。
text_en: The statistical time points were 0, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60 and 72 hours after the start of preservation, and the number of fish still alive in each group at each time point was counted.

quote: Ammonia nitrogen concentration was measured using Nessler’s Reagent Method by ammonia nitrogen detector (YC7200-N, Shenzhen, China); pH was measured with Sigma pH meter (PH818, Dongguan, China); dissolved oxygen was measured with dissolved oxygen meter (AR8210, Dongguan, China). The nitrite concentration was determined using the N-(1-naphthyl) ethylenediamine dihydrochloride method by microplate reader (Multiskan SkyHigh, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).
statement: 氨氮浓度使用纳氏试剂法通过氨氮检测仪测量；pH值使用Sigma pH计测量；溶解氧使用溶解氧仪测量；亚硝酸盐浓度使用N-(1-萘基)乙二胺盐酸盐法通过酶标仪测定。
text_zh: 氨氮浓度使用纳氏试剂法通过氨氮检测仪测量；pH值使用Sigma pH计测量；溶解氧使用溶解氧仪测量；亚硝酸盐浓度使用N-(1-萘基)乙二胺盐酸盐法通过酶标仪测定。
text_en: Ammonia nitrogen concentration was measured using the Nessler's reagent method with an ammonia nitrogen detector; pH was measured using a Sigma pH meter; dissolved oxygen was measured using a dissolved oxygen meter; nitrite concentration was determined using the N-(1-naphthyl)ethylenediamine dihydrochloride method with a microplate reader.

quote: According to the instructions of the reagent kit produced by Beijing Solaibao Technology Co., Ltd., lactate and muscle glycogen were measured.
statement: 乳酸和肌肉糖原的含量按照北京索莱宝科技有限公司生产的试剂盒说明书进行测定。
text_zh: 乳酸和肌肉糖原的含量按照北京索莱宝科技有限公司生产的试剂盒说明书进行测定。
text_en: The contents of lactate and muscle glycogen were determined according to the instructions of the kits produced by Beijing Solarbio Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
intervention: Kit assay of lactate and glycogen
intervention_record: 试剂盒测定乳酸和糖原

quote: The cortisol (COR) in serum was performed using the Shanghai Jingkang enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay kit, and the experiment was carried out according to the kit instructions.
statement: 血清皮质醇（COR）使用上海精科酶联免疫吸附测定试剂盒进行检测，实验按照试剂盒说明书进行。
text_zh: 血清皮质醇（COR）使用上海精科酶联免疫吸附测定试剂盒进行检测，实验按照试剂盒说明书进行。
text_en: Serum cortisol (COR) was detected using a Shanghai Jingke enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay kit, and the experiment was performed according to the kit instructions.

quote: The activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD) and glutathione peroxidase (GPX), as well as the content of malondialdehyde (MDA), were determined using commercial assay kits provided by Beijing Solarbio Science & Technology Co., Ltd. (Beijing, China).
statement: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPX）的活性以及丙二醛（MDA）的含量使用北京索莱宝科技有限公司提供的商业试剂盒测定。
text_zh: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPX）的活性以及丙二醛（MDA）的含量使用北京索莱宝科技有限公司提供的商业试剂盒测定。
text_en: The activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD) and glutathione peroxidase (GPX), as well as the content of malondialdehyde (MDA), were determined using commercial kits provided by Beijing Solarbio Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
intervention_record: 抗氧化指标试剂盒检测

quote: Histological examinations of the gill, liver, and muscle were conducted using HE staining and observed under a light microscope (Eclipse Ci, Nikon, Tokyo, Japan), following the methods of Peng et al. [ 61 ] and Zhong et al. [ 62 ].
statement: 鳃、肝脏和肌肉的组织学检查采用HE染色并在光学显微镜下观察，遵循Peng等人[61]和Zhong等人[62]的方法。
text_zh: 鳃、肝脏和肌肉的组织学检查采用HE染色并在光学显微镜下观察，遵循Peng等人[61]和Zhong等人[62]的方法。
text_en: Histological examination of the gills, liver, and muscle was performed using HE staining and observed under an optical microscope, following the methods of Peng et al. [61] and Zhong et al. [62].

quote: Elevated TDS levels often reflect the accumulation of metabolic waste and can serve as an indirect indicator of deteriorating water quality, increased physiological stress, and impaired osmoregulatory function in fish
statement: TDS水平升高通常反映代谢废物的积累，并可作为鱼类水质恶化、生理应激增加和渗透调节功能受损的间接指标。
text_zh: TDS水平升高通常反映代谢废物的积累，并可作为鱼类水质恶化、生理应激增加和渗透调节功能受损的间接指标。
text_en: Elevated TDS levels usually reflect the accumulation of metabolic waste and can serve as an indirect indicator of deteriorating water quality, increased physiological stress, and impaired osmoregulatory function in fish.

quote: Moreover, the elevated concentration of ammonia nitrogen also contributed to the increase in TDS (Figure 3).
statement: 此外，氨氮浓度的升高也导致了TDS的增加。
text_zh: 此外，氨氮浓度的升高也导致了TDS的增加。
text_en: In addition, the increase in ammonia nitrogen concentration also led to an increase in TDS.

quote: As shown in Figure 4 A, the LDH (lactate dehydrogenase) concentrations in the control, NaCl compound, and eugenol compound groups initially decreased and then increased as transportation time was extended.
statement: 如图4A所示，对照组、NaCl复合物组和丁香酚复合物组的LDH浓度随着运输时间的延长先降低后升高。
text_zh: 如图4A所示，对照组、NaCl复合物组和丁香酚复合物组的LDH浓度随着运输时间的延长先降低后升高。
text_en: As shown in Figure 4A, the LDH concentrations in the control group, the NaCl complex group, and the eugenol complex group first decreased and then increased with increasing transport time.

quote: The LDH concentration of ginger group and microcapsule group showed a decreasing trend with the prolongation of transportation time.
statement: 生姜组和微胶囊组的LDH浓度随着运输时间的延长呈下降趋势。
text_zh: 生姜组和微胶囊组的LDH浓度随着运输时间的延长呈下降趋势。
text_en: LDH concentrations in the ginger group and the microcapsule group showed a decreasing trend with increasing transport time.

quote: At 48 h of transportation, the LDH concentration in the control group was the highest, while the LDH concentrations in the NaCl and eugenol compound groups were significantly higher than those in the ginger and microcapsule groups (p
statement: 在运输48小时后，对照组的LDH浓度最高，而NaCl和丁香酚复合物组的LDH浓度显著高于生姜组和微胶囊组。
text_zh: 在运输48小时后，对照组的LDH浓度最高，而NaCl和丁香酚复合物组的LDH浓度显著高于生姜组和微胶囊组。
text_en: After 48 hours of transport, the LDH concentration was highest in the control group, and the LDH concentrations in the NaCl and eugenol complex groups were significantly higher than those in the ginger group and the microcapsule group.
counterevidence: 相比生姜和微胶囊组，NaCl组LDH更高

quote: In recent years, epidermal papillomas have been observed on the scales, fins and opercula of adult fish in many fish farms in the Chongming county of Shanghai, China.
statement: 近年来，在上海崇明县的许多养殖场中，观察到成年异育银鲫的鳞片、鳍和鳃盖上有表皮乳头状瘤。
text_zh: 近年来，在上海崇明县的许多养殖场中，观察到成年异育银鲫的鳞片、鳍和鳃盖上有表皮乳头状瘤。
text_en: In recent years, epidermal papillomas have been observed on the scales, fins, and gill covers of adult allotriploid gibel carp in many farms in Chongming County, Shanghai.

population.species: allogynogenetic crucian carp Carassius auratus gibelio (f) × Cyprinus carpio var. singuonensis (m)

quote: The disease appears in the late autumn of the first year and becomes more severe in winter.
statement: 该疾病在第一年晚秋出现，并在冬季变得更加严重。
text_zh: 该疾病在第一年晚秋出现，并在冬季变得更加严重。
text_en: The disease appeared in late autumn of the first year and became more severe during winter.

population.species: allogynogenetic crucian carp Carassius auratus gibelio (f) × Cyprinus carpio var. singuonensis (m)

quote: It gradually regresses in the late spring or summer of the second year, as water temperature increases.
statement: 随着水温升高，该疾病在第二年晚春或夏季逐渐消退。
text_zh: 随着水温升高，该疾病在第二年晚春或夏季逐渐消退。
text_en: As water temperature rises, the disease gradually subsides in late spring or summer of the second year.

population.species: allogynogenetic crucian carp Carassius auratus gibelio (f) × Cyprinus carpio var. singuonensis (m)

outcome: 疾病自然消退与水温的关系

quote: Epidermal papillomas were most prevalent in the late autumn and winter, as water temperatures declined.
statement: 表皮乳头状瘤在晚秋和冬季最为流行，此时水温下降。
text_zh: 表皮乳头状瘤在晚秋和冬季最为流行，此时水温下降。
text_en: Epidermal papillomas are most prevalent in late autumn and winter, when water temperatures drop.
