quote: In recent years, epidermal papillomas on the surfaces of scales, fins and opercula in 2 yr old or older ACC have been reported during low temperature sea-sons.
statement: 近年来，在低温季节，2岁或以上的异源雌核发育鲫鱼的鳞片、鳍和鳃盖表面报告了表皮乳头状瘤。
text_zh: 近年来，在低温季节，2岁或以上的异源雌核发育鲫鱼的鳞片、鳍和鳃盖表面报告了表皮乳头状瘤。
text_en: In recent years, epidermal papillomas have been reported on the scales, fins, and gill covers of gynogenetic crucian carp aged 2 years or older during low-temperature seasons.

quote: The incidence of this disease varies widely and can be as high as 90% in some ponds.
statement: 该疾病的发病率差异很大，在某些池塘中可高达90%。
text_zh: 该疾病的发病率差异很大，在某些池塘中可高达90%。
text_en: The incidence of this disease varies greatly, reaching up to 90% in some ponds.

quote: Ginger extract added to water effectively alleviated stress (COR), and oxidative damage (SOD and GPX) and improved muscle quality during (shear force, drip loss) early transport but lost efficacy over time.
statement: 添加到水中的姜提取物在运输早期有效缓解了应激（皮质醇）和氧化损伤（SOD和GPX），并改善了肌肉品质（剪切力、滴水损失），但随着时间推移效果减弱。
text_zh: 添加到水中的姜提取物在运输早期有效缓解了应激（皮质醇）和氧化损伤（SOD和GPX），并改善了肌肉品质（剪切力、滴水损失），但随着时间推移效果减弱。
text_en: Ginger extract added to the water effectively alleviated stress (cortisol) and oxidative damage (SOD and GPX) in the early stage of transport, and improved muscle quality (shear force, drip loss), but the effect weakened over time.
intervention: Ginger extract added directly to water
intervention_record: 姜提取物直接加入水中
outcome: 应激反应、氧化损伤、肌肉品质

quote: In contrast, microencapsulated ginger extract provided sustained antioxidant protection, stabilized water quality, and improved survival and muscle quality.
statement: 相比之下，微胶囊化姜提取物提供了持续的抗氧化保护，稳定了水质，并提高了存活率和肌肉品质。
text_zh: 相比之下，微胶囊化姜提取物提供了持续的抗氧化保护，稳定了水质，并提高了存活率和肌肉品质。
text_en: In contrast, microencapsulated ginger extract provided sustained antioxidant protection, stabilized water quality, and improved survival rate and muscle quality.
outcome: 抗氧化保护、水质稳定性、存活率、肌肉品质

quote: While the combination of NaCl and ginger extract accelerated water quality deterioration,
statement: 氯化钠与姜提取物的组合加速了水质的恶化。
text_zh: 氯化钠与姜提取物的组合加速了水质的恶化。
text_en: The combination of sodium chloride and ginger extract accelerated the deterioration of water quality.

quote: the combination of eugenol and ginger extract effectively reduced ammonia accumulation, oxidative stress, and muscle damage.
statement: 丁香酚与姜提取物的组合有效减少了氨积累、氧化应激和肌肉损伤。
text_zh: 丁香酚与姜提取物的组合有效减少了氨积累、氧化应激和肌肉损伤。
text_en: The combination of eugenol and ginger extract effectively reduced ammonia accumulation, oxidative stress, and muscle damage.
intervention_record: 姜提取物与丁香酚组合
outcome: 氨积累、氧化应激、肌肉损伤

quote: The observed effects may be attributed to the anesthetic properties of eugenol, which helped mitigate oxidative stress and enhance fish survival.
statement: 观察到的效果可能归因于丁香酚的麻醉特性，这有助于减轻氧化应激并提高鱼类存活率。
text_zh: 观察到的效果可能归因于丁香酚的麻醉特性，这有助于减轻氧化应激并提高鱼类存活率。
text_en: The observed effects may be attributed to the anesthetic properties of eugenol, which help reduce oxidative stress and improve fish survival rates.

quote: Additionally, the combination improved muscle quality by increasing shear force, reducing drip loss, and inhibiting the extrinsic apoptotic pathway.
statement: 此外，该组合通过增加剪切力、减少滴水损失和抑制外源性凋亡途径来改善肌肉品质。
text_zh: 此外，该组合通过增加剪切力、减少滴水损失和抑制外源性凋亡途径来改善肌肉品质。
text_en: In addition, this combination improves muscle quality by increasing shear force, reducing drip loss, and inhibiting the extrinsic apoptosis pathway.
intervention_record: 姜提取物与丁香酚组合

quote: 近年組織培養により鱗上皮細胞から,材料魚を殺すことなく染色体を観察できるようになつた
statement: 组织培养技术使得可以从鳞片上皮细胞观察染色体，而无需杀死实验鱼。
text_zh: 组织培养技术使得可以从鳞片上皮细胞观察染色体，而无需杀死实验鱼。
text_en: Tissue culture technology allows chromosomes to be observed from scale epithelial cells without killing the experimental fish.

quote:
In diseased fish reared in indoor aquaria from Febru-
ary 2006 to May 2007 under natural temperature con-
ditions, the hyperplasia of tumours ceased to progress
in April 2006 as water temperature increased to about
18°C.
statement: 在室内水族箱中饲养的患病鱼，在自然温度条件下，随着水温升至约18°C，肿瘤增生于2006年4月停止进展。
text_zh: 在室内水族箱中饲养的患病鱼，在自然温度条件下，随着水温升至约18°C，肿瘤增生于2006年4月停止进展。

quote:
As temperature further increased, tumours
became dark, shrank in the late spring and disap-
peared in all diseased fish between June and July
when water temperature was 28 to 32°C.
statement: 随着温度进一步升高，肿瘤变黑、在春末缩小，并在水温为28至32°C的六月和七月之间在所有患病鱼中消失。
text_zh: 随着温度进一步升高，肿瘤变黑、在春末缩小，并在水温为28至32°C的六月和七月之间在所有患病鱼中消失。
text_en: As the temperature rose further, tumors darkened, shrank in late spring, and disappeared between June and July at water temperatures of 28 to 32°C in all affected fish.

population.species: Carassius auratus gibelio (f) × Cyprinus carpio var. singuonensis (m)

quote:
Tumours
reappeared again in some fish in October when water
temperature declined to about 20°C and enlarged as
temperature further declined towards winter.
statement: 当水温降至约20°C时，部分鱼体内的肿瘤在十月再次出现，并随着气温向冬季进一步下降而增大。
text_zh: 当水温降至约20°C时，部分鱼体内的肿瘤在十月再次出现，并随着气温向冬季进一步下降而增大。
text_en: When the water temperature dropped to about 20°C, tumors in some fish reappeared in October and increased in size as the air temperature further decreased toward winter.

population.species: Carassius auratus gibelio (f) × Cyprinus carpio var. singuonensis (m)

quote:
The inci-
dence of disease reoccurrence was 55.0%.
statement: 疾病复发的发生率为55.0%。
text_zh: 疾病复发的发生率为55.0%。
text_en: The incidence of disease recurrence was 55.0%.

population.species: Carassius auratus gibelio (f) × Cyprinus carpio var. singuonensis (m)

quote:
Artificial infection with a filtered tumour homogenate
induced epidermal hyperplasia on the scales of 2
among 14 healthy fish after 35 d (14.3%).
statement: 用过滤后的肿瘤匀浆进行人工感染，在35天后诱导了14条健康鱼中的2条（14.3%）鳞片上的表皮增生。
text_zh: 用过滤后的肿瘤匀浆进行人工感染，在35天后诱导了14条健康鱼中的2条（14.3%）鳞片上的表皮增生。
text_en: Artificial infection with filtered tumor homogenate induced epidermal hyperplasia on the scales of 2 out of 14 healthy fish (14.3%) after 35 days.

population.species: Carassius auratus gibelio (f) × Cyprinus carpio var. singuonensis (m)

However, the symptoms disappeared as water temper-
ature increased in late spring.
statement: 然而，随着春末水温升高，症状消失。
text_zh: 然而，随着春末水温升高，症状消失。
text_en: However, as water temperatures rose in late spring, the symptoms disappeared.

statement: 仔魚に見られた頭部の短縮は、遺伝的要因ではなく飼育環境の影響による形態の歪化であると推定されている。

text_en: The head shortening observed in larvae is presumed to be a morphological distortion caused by the rearing environment rather than genetic factors.

statement: 氯化钠复合组：注入充氧自来水，添加姜提取物（0.1 mg/mL）和氯化钠（3 g/L）。

quote: A limitation of this study is that it only investigated the combined effects of NaCl or eugenol with ginger extract, without including treatment groups with NaCl or eugenol alone.
statement: 本研究的局限性在于仅调查了氯化钠或丁香酚与姜提取物的联合效应，未包含单独使用氯化钠或丁香酚的处理组。

text_en: The limitation of this study is that it only investigated the combined effects of sodium chloride or eugenol with ginger extract, and did not include treatment groups using sodium chloride or eugenol alone.

quote: The Effects of Different Addition Methods of Ginger Extract on Stress Response and Muscle Quality of Fish
statement: 不同添加方式的姜提取物对鱼类应激反应和肌肉品质的影响。
text_zh: 不同添加方式的姜提取物对鱼类应激反应和肌肉品质的影响。
text_en: The effects of ginger extract administered via different methods on fish stress response and muscle quality.

statement: 使用120 mg/L的MS-222麻醉剂实施安乐死。
text_zh: 使用120 mg/L的MS-222麻醉剂实施安乐死。
text_en: Euthanasia was performed using 120 mg/L of MS-222 anesthetic.

quote: Blood was collected from the caudal vein using a 5 mL sterile syringe.
statement: 使用5毫升无菌注射器从尾静脉采集血液。

quote: Under the special stress of high salt and high alkali, the intestinal microorganisms of these fish are more likely to help the host adapt to the extreme environment by synthesizing salt-tolerant metabolites and regulating intestinal osmotic pressure balance [ 26 ].
statement: 在高盐高碱的特殊胁迫下，鱼类的肠道微生物更有可能通过合成耐盐代谢物和调节肠道渗透压平衡来帮助宿主适应极端环境。

text_en: Under the special stress of high salinity and high alkalinity, fish gut microbiota are more likely to help hosts adapt to extreme environments by synthesizing salt-tolerant metabolites and regulating intestinal osmotic balance.

text_en: This study used a portable multi-parameter water quality analyzer to measure physicochemical indicators of the water body, including water temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH, salinity, and total dissolved solids, on site.

quote: Tap water culture: 20 diseased fish were reared in an indoor aquarium containing 850 l of tap water from February 2006 to May 2007 for about 15 mo under nat-ural temperature.
statement: 在室内水族箱中饲养20条患病鱼，使用850升自来水，从2006年2月到2007年5月约15个月，处于自然温度下。
text_zh: 在室内水族箱中饲养20条患病鱼，使用850升自来水，从2006年2月到2007年5月约15个月，处于自然温度下。

quote: Fish were fed with a commercial dry pellet diet, and 70 to 100% of the water was changed daily.
statement: 鱼类喂食商业干颗粒饲料，每天更换70%至100%的水。
text_zh: 鱼类喂食商业干颗粒饲料，每天更换70%至100%的水。
text_en: Fish were fed commercial dry pellet feed, with 70% to 100% of the water changed daily.

quote: During the culture period, the symptoms and behaviour of diseased fish and water temperature were carefully monitored and recorded.
statement: 在养殖期间，仔细监测并记录患病鱼的症状、行为以及水温。
text_zh: 在养殖期间，仔细监测并记录患病鱼的症状、行为以及水温。
text_en: During the farming period, carefully monitor and record the symptoms, behavior, and water temperature of sick fish.

quote: Two groups of 14 healthy fish were separately reared in 2 aquaria containing 850 l of tap water at 7 to 10°C in winter.
statement: 两组各14条健康鱼分别饲养在含有850升自来水的两个水族箱中，冬季水温为7至10°C。
text_zh: 两组各14条健康鱼分别饲养在含有850升自来水的两个水族箱中，冬季水温为7至10°C。
text_en: Two groups of 14 healthy fish each were reared in two aquaria containing 850 liters of tap water, with winter water temperatures of 7 to 10°C.

quote: Their scales were scarified by a scalpel.

text_en: Their scales were scratched with a scalpel.

quote: The scales of the 14 healthy fish in the experimental group were smeared with the filtrate, whereas the scales of the 14 healthy fish in the control group were smeared with PBS.

text_en: The scales of 14 healthy fish in the experimental group were coated with filtrate, while the scales of 14 healthy fish in the control group were coated with PBS.

statement: MS-222 at a concentration of 0.6–1.0 g/L was used to euthanize the fish after capture.
text_en: MS-222 at a concentration of 0.6–1.0 g/L was used to euthanize the fish after capture.

quote: the fish was disinfected with 75% anhydrous ethanol
statement: The fish were disinfected with 75% anhydrous ethanol.
text_en: The fish were disinfected with 75% anhydrous ethanol.

quote:
Epidermal papillomas were
observed only in fish 2 yr of age or older.
statement: 表皮乳突瘤仅在2岁或以上的鱼中被观察到。
text_zh: 表皮乳突瘤仅在2岁或以上的鱼中被观察到。
text_en: Epidermal papillomas were observed only in fish aged 2 years or older.

quote:
The mortality of
diseased fish was low at approximately 10%.
statement: 患病鱼的死亡率较低，约为10%。
text_zh: 患病鱼的死亡率较低，约为10%。
text_en: The mortality rate of diseased fish was low, about 10%.

quote:
However,
higher mortalities of diseased fish, associated with
handling stress and crowding in the net or transporta-
tion, reached values higher than 95%, depending on
the degree of stress.
statement: 然而，与操作应激、网箱拥挤或运输相关的患病鱼死亡率更高，取决于应激程度，可达95%以上。
text_zh: 然而，与操作应激、网箱拥挤或运输相关的患病鱼死亡率更高，取决于应激程度，可达95%以上。
text_en: However, the mortality rate of diseased fish associated with handling stress, cage crowding or transport is higher, reaching over 95% depending on the degree of stress.

quote:
Although 1 yr old or younger fish
were always cultured together with adult diseased fish
in the same earthen pond, no symptoms of the disease
appeared in young fish.
statement: 尽管1岁或更小的鱼总是与成年患病鱼在同一土塘中混养，但幼鱼未出现疾病症状。
text_zh: 尽管1岁或更小的鱼总是与成年患病鱼在同一土塘中混养，但幼鱼未出现疾病症状。
text_en: Although fish aged 1 year or younger were always co-cultured in the same earthen ponds with adult diseased fish, the juveniles did not show disease symptoms.

quote:
When other species—such as
glass carp, silver carp, bighead carp and bluntsnout
bream—were cultured with diseased ACCs in the
same pond they did not develop the disease.
statement: 当其他物种（如玻璃鲤、银鲤、鳙鱼和钝吻鲷）与患病ACC在同一池塘养殖时，它们没有患上该病。
text_zh: 当其他物种（如玻璃鲤、银鲤、鳙鱼和钝吻鲷）与患病ACC在同一池塘养殖时，它们没有患上该病。
text_en: When other species (such as glass carp, silver carp, bighead carp, and blunt snout bream) were co-cultured in the same pond with diseased ACC, they did not contract the disease.

quote: Diet is considered an important factor influencing the gut microbiota.
statement: 饮食被认为是影响肠道微生物群的重要因素。
text_zh: 饮食被认为是影响肠道微生物群的重要因素。
text_en: Diet is considered an important factor affecting the gut microbiota.

quote: Therefore, diet has been reported to be the main cause of changes in the composition of the microbiota of rainbow trout [ 8 , 9 ].
statement: 据报道，饮食是虹鳟鱼微生物群组成变化的主要原因。
text_zh: 据报道，饮食是虹鳟鱼微生物群组成变化的主要原因。
text_en: Diet is reported to be the main cause of changes in the microbiota composition of rainbow trout.

quote: Destruction of the intestinal microbiota due to dietary habits usually affects the function of the digestive organ by impairing the production of bacterial digestive enzymes [ 10 ].
statement: 由饮食习惯引起的肠道微生物群破坏通常通过损害细菌消化酶的产生来影响消化器官的功能。
text_zh: 由饮食习惯引起的肠道微生物群破坏通常通过损害细菌消化酶的产生来影响消化器官的功能。
text_en: Gut microbiota disruption caused by dietary habits usually affects the function of digestive organs by impairing the production of bacterial digestive enzymes.

quote: This may be the reason for the common symptom of a white mucus layer on the tumour surface when fish were stressed by handling and crowding in the net or during transportation.
statement: 这可能是当鱼类因操作、网箱拥挤或运输而受到应激时，肿瘤表面出现白色粘液层这一常见症状的原因。
text_zh: 这可能是当鱼类因操作、网箱拥挤或运输而受到应激时，肿瘤表面出现白色粘液层这一常见症状的原因。
text_en: This may be the reason for the common symptom of a white mucus layer appearing on the surface of tumors when fish are stressed due to handling, crowding in nets, or transportation.

statement: Fish were transported live to Shanghai Ocean University and kept in aquaria.
text_en: Fish were transported live to Shanghai Ocean University and kept in aquaria.

Clinical observation and epizootiology. The ap-
pearance and developmental processes of diseased
fish were observed from October 2005 to September
2007.
statement: 从2005年10月到2007年9月观察了病鱼的外观和发育过程。
text_zh: 从2005年10月到2007年9月观察了病鱼的外观和发育过程。

quote:
Epizootic investigation was made by visiting the
fish farms and questioning farmers.
statement: 通过访问养鱼场和询问农民进行了流行病学调查。
text_zh: 通过访问养鱼场和询问农民进行了流行病学调查。
text_en: An epidemiological survey was conducted by visiting fish farms and questioning farmers.
outcome: 养殖环境与健康状况背景

quote:
Examination of para-
sites: Wet mounts of epidermal papillomas from the
scales, fins and opercula, and of gills and internal
organs of diseased fish were prepared and observed
under a light microscope.
statement: 寄生虫检查：制备了来自鳞片、鳍、鳃盖以及病鱼鳃和内部器官表皮乳突的湿片，并在光学显微镜下观察。
text_zh: 寄生虫检查：制备了来自鳞片、鳍、鳃盖以及病鱼鳃和内部器官表皮乳突的湿片，并在光学显微镜下观察。
text_en: Parasite examination: Wet mounts were prepared from scales, fins, gill covers, and the epidermal papillae of the gills and internal organs of diseased fish, and observed under an optical microscope.

quote:
Ten diseased fish were
examined each month during the high prevalence
season from September 2006 to March 2007.
statement: 在2006年9月至2007年3月的高流行季节期间，每月检查十条病鱼。
text_zh: 在2006年9月至2007年3月的高流行季节期间，每月检查十条病鱼。

quote:
The
tumour surface was seared with a heated scalpel
blade and the tumour tissue was sampled with an
inoculating loop.
statement: 肿瘤表面用加热的刀片烧灼，并用接种环采集肿瘤组织。
text_zh: 肿瘤表面用加热的刀片烧灼，并用接种环采集肿瘤组织。
text_en: The tumor surface was cauterized with a heated blade, and tumor tissue was collected using an inoculation loop.
outcome: 实验操作造成的物理损伤

quote:
In order to
avoid the possibility of omission of some bacterial
pathogens, different isolation media were used.
statement: 为了避免遗漏某些细菌病原体，使用了不同的分离培养基。
text_zh: 为了避免遗漏某些细菌病原体，使用了不同的分离培养基。
text_en: Different isolation media were used to avoid missing certain bacterial pathogens.

quote: The results of this study provide a detailed basis for further understanding the symbiotic mechanism between freshwater fish and intestinal microorganisms and also provide theoretical support and practical guidance for maintaining the intestinal microecological balance of fish and improving the health and breeding efficiency of fish by optimizing feed formula and regulating breeding environment in aquaculture.
statement: 本研究结果为通过优化饲料配方和调节养殖环境来维持鱼类肠道微生态平衡、改善鱼类健康和养殖效率提供了理论支持和实践指导。
text_zh: 本研究结果为通过优化饲料配方和调节养殖环境来维持鱼类肠道微生态平衡、改善鱼类健康和养殖效率提供了理论支持和实践指导。
text_en: The results of this study provide theoretical support and practical guidance for maintaining fish gut microbiota balance, improving fish health and aquaculture efficiency through optimizing feed formulation and regulating the farming environment.
intervention_record: 优化饲料配方和养殖环境
outcome: 肠道微生态平衡与健康

quote: In the future, it is necessary to carry out cross-seasonal monitoring, combine multi-omics to verify the function of flora, and verify the effect of probiotics through breeding experiments so as to promote the transformation of basic research into the industry.
statement: 未来需要进行跨季节监测，结合多组学验证菌群功能，并通过养殖实验验证益生菌的效果，以促进基础研究向产业转化。
text_zh: 未来需要进行跨季节监测，结合多组学验证菌群功能，并通过养殖实验验证益生菌的效果，以促进基础研究向产业转化。
text_en: Future work requires cross-seasonal monitoring, combined with multi-omics validation of microbial community functions, and verification of probiotic effects through aquaculture experiments, to promote the translation of basic research into industrial application.

quote: The collection of, treatment, and experimental procedures on fish were conducted in accordance with the guidelines of the Dalian Ocean University (DLOU) and were approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee of DLOU (DLOU2024018).
statement: 鱼类的采集、处理和实验程序均按照大连海洋大学指南进行，并获得了该机构动物护理和使用委员会的批准。
text_zh: 鱼类的采集、处理和实验程序均按照大连海洋大学指南进行，并获得了该机构动物护理和使用委员会的批准。
text_en: The collection, handling, and experimental procedures for fish were conducted in accordance with the guidelines of Dalian Ocean University and were approved by the institution's Animal Care and Use Committee.

quote: Water conditions were consistently controlled throughout the trial. The temperature ranged from 22 °C to 24 °C and continuous aeration.
statement: 在整个试验期间，水质条件得到持续控制，温度范围为22°C至24°C，并进行连续曝气。
text_zh: 在整个试验期间，水质条件得到持续控制，温度范围为22°C至24°C，并进行连续曝气。
text_en: Throughout the entire trial period, water quality conditions were continuously controlled, with a temperature range of 22°C to 24°C and continuous aeration.

statement: Fish were anesthetized with 0.1% benzocaine for 10 minutes after 4 hours.
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with 0.1% benzocaine for 10 minutes after 4 hours.

text_en: The base of the fish tail is cut, and blood is drained for 10 minutes to ensure death.

text_en: Naslov rada istražuje utjecaj promjena temperature vode na eritrocitni profil vrste Carassius gibelio.

statement: 再过2到3小时后，使用0.1%苯佐卡因对鱼进行麻醉10分钟。
text_zh: 再过2到3小时后，使用0.1%苯佐卡因对鱼进行麻醉10分钟。
text_en: After another 2 to 3 hours, the fish are anesthetized with 0.1% benzocaine for 10 minutes.

text_zh: 将草药提取物添加到处理皿的河水中，最终浓度为12.5和25.0 mg/ml。
text_en: Herbal extract was added to the river water in the treatment dishes, at final concentrations of 12.5 and 25.0 mg/ml.

text_zh: 水霉菌种被认为涉及显著的污染，影响活鱼、死鱼及其鱼卵。
text_en: Saprolegnia species are considered to be involved in significant contamination, affecting live fish, dead fish and their eggs.

statement: Tablica prikazuje parametre eritrocitne loze za kontrolnu skupinu i skupinu šarana (babuška) koja je bila izložena toplinskom tretmanu.
text_en: Tablica prikazuje parametre eritrocitne loze za kontrolnu skupinu i skupinu šarana (babuška) koja je bila izložena toplinskom tretmanu.

quote: Eggs with hyphae were immediately removed for fungal isolation according to Ghiasi et al. (2010), and mortalities were recorded.
statement: 带有菌丝的鱼卵被立即移除以进行真菌分离，并记录死亡率。
text_zh: 带有菌丝的鱼卵被立即移除以进行真菌分离，并记录死亡率。
text_en: Fish eggs with hyphae were immediately removed for fungal isolation, and mortality was recorded.

quote: During egg incubation, oomycete produce mycelia which grow and spread from dead to healthy eggs causing major financial losses.
statement: 在卵孵化期间，卵菌产生菌丝体，从死卵生长并扩散到健康卵，造成重大经济损失。
text_zh: 在卵孵化期间，卵菌产生菌丝体，从死卵生长并扩散到健康卵，造成重大经济损失。
text_en: During egg hatching, oomycetes produce mycelium that grows from dead eggs and spreads to healthy eggs, causing significant economic losses.

quote: Control of saprolegniasis is a problem since the effective malachite green treatment has been banned worldwide.
statement: 由于有效的孔雀石绿处理已在全球范围内被禁止，水霉病的控制成为一个问题。
text_zh: 由于有效的孔雀石绿处理已在全球范围内被禁止，水霉病的控制成为一个问题。
text_en: Since effective malachite green treatment has been banned globally, the control of saprolegniasis has become a problem.

quote: Pseudolarix kaempferi Gord. (Pinaceae) was one of 20 Chinese herbs screened as a potential drug for controlling Saprolegnia infection.
statement: 金钱松（松科）是筛选出的20种中国草药中用于控制水霉感染的潜在药物之一。
text_zh: 金钱松（松科）是筛选出的20种中国草药中用于控制水霉感染的潜在药物之一。
text_en: Pseudolarix kaempferi (Pinaceae) is one of the 20 screened Chinese herbs used as a potential drug for controlling water mold infections.

quote: The minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of 20 Chinese herbs was screened. Pseudolarix kaempferi Gord. (Pinaceae) was the most effective in inhibiting growth of the bacteria and was chosen for further trial.
statement: 筛选了20种中草药的最小抑菌浓度，金钱松被证明对抑制细菌生长最有效并被选用于进一步试验。
text_zh: 筛选了20种中草药的最小抑菌浓度，金钱松被证明对抑制细菌生长最有效并被选用于进一步试验。
text_en: The minimum inhibitory concentrations of 20 Chinese herbal medicines were screened; *Pseudolarix amabilis* (golden larch) was proven to be the most effective in inhibiting bacterial growth and was selected for further trials.

quote: Significant protective efficacy of 52.63% and 73.68% was obtained against the JL strain in Pengze crucian carp eggs at P. kaempferi concentrations of 12.5 mg/ml and 25.0 mg/ml, respectively.
statement: 在彭泽鲫卵中，使用浓度为12.5 mg/ml和25.0 mg/ml的金钱松提取物，分别获得了针对JL菌株52.63%和73.68%的显著保护效力。
text_zh: 在彭泽鲫卵中，使用浓度为12.5 mg/ml和25.0 mg/ml的金钱松提取物，分别获得了针对JL菌株52.63%和73.68%的显著保护效力。
text_en: In Pengze crucian carp eggs, using Pseudolarix amabilis extract at concentrations of 12.5 mg/ml and 25.0 mg/ml achieved significant protective efficacy of 52.63% and 73.68%, respectively, against the JL strain.

quote: Eggs in the control and treatment dishes were then challenged with the zoospore suspension at a concentration of 1 × 106/ml.
statement: 对照和处理组中的鱼卵随后以1×10^6/ml浓度的游动孢子悬浮液进行攻毒挑战。
text_zh: 对照和处理组中的鱼卵随后以1×10^6/ml浓度的游动孢子悬浮液进行攻毒挑战。
text_en: Fish eggs in the control and treatment groups were subsequently challenged with a motile spore suspension at a concentration of 1×10^6/ml.

quote: Eight different fungal isolates were obtained from the infected eggs, but only one strain, named JL, was pathogenic, resulting in 45% mortality.
statement: 从受感染的鱼卵中获得了八种不同的真菌分离株，但只有一种名为JL的菌株具有致病性，导致45%的死亡率。
text_zh: 从受感染的鱼卵中获得了八种不同的真菌分离株，但只有一种名为JL的菌株具有致病性，导致45%的死亡率。
text_en: Eight different fungal isolates were obtained from infected fish eggs, but only one strain named JL was pathogenic, causing a 45% mortality rate.

quote: To date, the few chemicals used to control saprolegniasis include hydrogen peroxide, salt, ozone, formaldehyde, and formalin formulations (Forneris et al., 2003; Rach et al., 2004; Gieseker et al., 2006), but these treatments do not totally arrest the growth of Saprolegnia species (Van West, 2006).
statement: 现有用于控制水霉病的化学药剂（如过氧化氢、盐、臭氧等）不能完全抑制水霉菌的生长。
text_zh: 现有用于控制水霉病的化学药剂（如过氧化氢、盐、臭氧等）不能完全抑制水霉菌的生长。
text_en: Existing chemical agents used to control saprolegniasis (such as hydrogen peroxide, salt, ozone, etc.) cannot completely inhibit the growth of Saprolegnia.

quote: In our study, P. kaempferi completely inhibited the growth of the JL strain and, at concentrations of 12.5 mg/ml and 25.0 mg/ml, exhibited significant protective efficacy of 52.63% and 73.68%, respectively, against experimental Saprolegnia infections of eggs.
statement: 在实验中，P. kaempferi完全抑制了JL菌株的生长，并在12.5 mg/ml和25.0 mg/ml浓度下对鱼卵的水霉感染表现出显著的保护效力。
text_zh: 在实验中，P. kaempferi完全抑制了JL菌株的生长，并在12.5 mg/ml和25.0 mg/ml浓度下对鱼卵的水霉感染表现出显著的保护效力。
text_en: In the experiment, P. kaempferi completely inhibited the growth of the JL strain and showed significant protective efficacy against water mold infection of fish eggs at concentrations of 12.5 mg/ml and 25.0 mg/ml.

quote: field trials showed that when P. kaempferi was applied for five days, the incidence rates of saprolegniosis were reduced by up to 80% in crucian carp eggs and Megalobrama amlycephala eggs at Sand Lake, Hubei, China (data not shown).
statement: 田间试验显示，施用P. kaempferi五天可将鲫鱼和团头鲂鱼卵的水霉病发病率降低高达80%。
text_zh: 田间试验显示，施用P. kaempferi五天可将鲫鱼和团头鲂鱼卵的水霉病发病率降低高达80%。
text_en: Field trials showed that applying P. kaempferi for five days reduced the incidence of water mold disease in crucian carp and blunt snout bream eggs by up to 80%.

quote: Pengze crucian carp eggs suffering from saprolegniosis, arrows show contaminated areas.
statement: 彭泽鲫卵遭受水霉病感染，图中箭头指示了受污染的区域。
text_zh: 彭泽鲫卵遭受水霉病感染，图中箭头指示了受污染的区域。
text_en: Pengze crucian carp eggs were infected with water mold disease; the arrows in the figure indicate the contaminated areas.

quote: Seven of the twenty herb extracts showed good inhibition effects on Saprolegnia growth, i.e., MIC was below 5.0 mg/ml
statement: 二十种草药提取物中有七种对水霉菌生长显示出良好的抑制作用，即最小抑菌浓度低于5.0 mg/ml。
text_zh: 二十种草药提取物中有七种对水霉菌生长显示出良好的抑制作用，即最小抑菌浓度低于5.0 mg/ml。
text_en: Seven out of twenty herbal extracts showed good inhibitory effects on the growth of water mold, that is, with a minimum inhibitory concentration below 5.0 mg/ml.

quote: Results suggest good protective effects of P. kaempferi for controlling Saprolegnia infection on crucian carp eggs
statement: 结果表明苦参（P. kaempferi）对控制鲫鱼卵上的水霉感染具有良好的保护效果。
text_zh: 结果表明苦参（P. kaempferi）对控制鲫鱼卵上的水霉感染具有良好的保护效果。
text_en: The results showed that Sophora flavescens (P. kaempferi) had a good protective effect against Saprolegnia infection on crucian carp eggs.

quote: Significant protective efficacy against the JL strain in eggs (52.63% and 73.68%) was obtained at concentrations of 12.5 mg/ml and 25.0 mg/ml, respectively.
statement: 在12.5 mg/ml和25.0 mg/ml的浓度下，分别获得了针对卵中JL菌株的显著保护效力（52.63%和73.68%）。
text_zh: 在12.5 mg/ml和25.0 mg/ml的浓度下，分别获得了针对卵中JL菌株的显著保护效力（52.63%和73.68%）。
text_en: At concentrations of 12.5 mg/ml and 25.0 mg/ml, significant protective efficacy against the JL strain in eggs was obtained (52.63% and 73.68%, respectively).

quote: Fig. 5. Control by Pseudolarix kaempferi Gord. (Pinaceae) extract of artificial infection of the JL strain of Saprolegnia on Pengze crucian carp eggs.
statement: 图5展示了香松提取物对彭泽鲤鱼卵上Saprolegnia JL菌株人工感染的控制效果。
text_zh: 图5展示了香松提取物对彭泽鲤鱼卵上Saprolegnia JL菌株人工感染的控制效果。
text_en: Figure 5 shows the control effect of Xiangsong extract on artificial infection of Saprolegnia JL strain on Pengze carp eggs.

quote: Seven isolipidic and isocarbohydrate experimental diets containing 21% (P21), 24% (P24), 27% (P27), 30% (P30), 33% (P33), 36% (P36), and 39% (P39) crude protein were formulated with fish meal and casein as protein sources.
statement: 研究配制了七种等脂等碳水化合物的实验日粮，粗蛋白水平分别为21%、24%、27%、30%、33%、36%和39%，以鱼粉和酪蛋白为蛋白质来源。
text_zh: 研究配制了七种等脂等碳水化合物的实验日粮，粗蛋白水平分别为21%、24%、27%、30%、33%、36%和39%，以鱼粉和酪蛋白为蛋白质来源。
text_en: Seven iso-lipid and iso-carbohydrate experimental diets were formulated with crude protein levels of 21%, 24%, 27%, 30%, 33%, 36% and 39%, using fish meal and casein as protein sources.

quote: About 1000 experimental fish, collected from the Breeding Center of Crucian Carp of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the People's Republic of China (Liangzi Lake Research Base, the Institute of Hydrobiology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Wuhan, Hubei, People's Republic of China), were acclimated in an indoor recirculating water system (gross water volume: 30 m 3) and fed with a commercial diet (103, Tongwei Co., Ltd.) for 2 weeks.
statement: 实验鱼在室内循环水系统中驯化两周，并投喂商业饲料。
text_zh: 实验鱼在室内循环水系统中驯化两周，并投喂商业饲料。
text_en: The experimental fish were acclimated for two weeks in an indoor recirculating aquaculture system and fed commercial feed.

quote: Before the growth trial, 420 similar size and apparent healthy fish (body weight: 9.73 ± 0.03 g) after 24 h fasting were randomly selected and equally distributed into 21 cylindrical fiberglass tanks (water volume: 285 L, water depth: 0.58 m)
statement: 生长试验前，对表观健康的鱼进行24小时禁食处理，然后随机分配到圆柱形玻璃钢水箱中。
text_zh: 生长试验前，对表观健康的鱼进行24小时禁食处理，然后随机分配到圆柱形玻璃钢水箱中。
text_en: Before the growth trial, apparently healthy fish were fasted for 24 hours and then randomly assigned to cylindrical fiberglass-reinforced plastic tanks.

quote: After 8-week feeding, weight gain rate (WGR) and specific growth rate (SGR) were lower in the P30 group than those in the P39 group, but no difference was found in final body weight (FBW), survival, condition factor (CF), or hepatosomatic index (HSI) between different groups.
statement: 在为期8周的喂养后，P30组的增重率和特定生长率低于P39组，但不同组间的终末体重、存活率、肥满度和肝体比没有差异。
text_zh: 在为期8周的喂养后，P30组的增重率和特定生长率低于P39组，但不同组间的终末体重、存活率、肥满度和肝体比没有差异。
text_en: After an 8-week feeding period, the weight gain rate and specific growth rate of the P30 group were lower than those of the P39 group, but there was no significant difference in final body weight, survival rate, condition factor, or hepatosomatic index among the groups.

quote: Increased dietary protein decreased feeding rate (FR) and viscerosomatic index (VSI) while improved feed efficiency (FE).
statement: 增加日粮蛋白质降低了摄食率和脏体比，同时提高了饲料效率。
text_zh: 增加日粮蛋白质降低了摄食率和脏体比，同时提高了饲料效率。
text_en: Increasing dietary protein decreased feed intake and viscera index, while improving feed efficiency.

population.species: 预ponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone (部分基因组来自白鲫 C. auratus cuvieri)

quote: Decreased protein retention efficiency (PRE) and improved activity of liver alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and content of plasma ammonia suggested intensified fish amino acid catabolism in high dietary protein groups.
statement: 高蛋白组中蛋白质保留效率降低以及肝脏丙氨酸氨基转移酶活性和血浆氨含量升高，表明鱼类氨基酸分解代谢增强。
text_zh: 高蛋白组中蛋白质保留效率降低以及肝脏丙氨酸氨基转移酶活性和血浆氨含量升高，表明鱼类氨基酸分解代谢增强。
text_en: The decreased protein retention efficiency and increased liver alanine aminotransferase activity and plasma ammonia content in the high-protein group indicate enhanced amino acid catabolism in fish.

population.species: 预ponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone (部分基因组来自白鲫 C. auratus cuvieri)

quote: The dietary protein requirement of the new Carassius clone was as low as 21.38% for growth.
statement: 该新克隆鲤用于生长的日粮蛋白质需求低至21.38%。
text_zh: 该新克隆鲤用于生长的日粮蛋白质需求低至21.38%。
text_en: The dietary protein requirement for growth of this newly cloned carp is as low as 21.38%.

population.species: 预ponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone (部分基因组来自白鲫 C. auratus cuvieri)

quote: High dietary protein might be harmful to the fish due to the increased contents of liver malondialdehyde (MDA) and plasma cortisol.
statement: 由于肝脏丙二醛和血浆皮质醇含量增加，高日粮蛋白质可能对鱼有害。
text_zh: 由于肝脏丙二醛和血浆皮质醇含量增加，高日粮蛋白质可能对鱼有害。
text_en: High dietary protein may be harmful to fish due to increased liver malondialdehyde and plasma cortisol content.

population.species: 预ponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone (部分基因组来自白鲫 C. auratus cuvieri)

quote: The activities of lipase (A054-2-1) and α-amylase (C016-1-1) in the midguts; alanine aminotransferase (ALT, C009-2-1), aspartate aminotransferase (AST, C010-2-1), and catalase (CAT, A007-1-1) in the livers; and the contents of glucose (GLU, A154-1-1), ammonia (A086-1-1), and cortisol (H094-1-2) in plasma, malondialdehyde (MDA, A003-1-2), and heat shock protein 70 (HSP70, H264-2-2) in the livers were assayed with commer
statement: 通过测定中肠脂肪酶和α-淀粉酶活性、肝脏转氨酶和过氧化氢酶活性以及血浆葡萄糖、氨和皮质醇含量，来评估鱼类的健康状况。
text_zh: 通过测定中肠脂肪酶和α-淀粉酶活性、肝脏转氨酶和过氧化氢酶活性以及血浆葡萄糖、氨和皮质醇含量，来评估鱼类的健康状况。
text_en: The health status of fish was assessed by measuring mid-intestine lipase and alpha-amylase activities, liver transaminase and catalase activities, and plasma glucose, ammonia, and cortisol levels.
outcome: 生理生化指标（应激与代谢）

quote: The test was carried out in nine glass petri dishes supplied with sterile filtered river water at 25°C. Each petri dish was randomly stocked with 40 healthy Pengze crucian carp eggs. These were challenged with the zoospore suspension at a concentration of 1 × 106/ml.
statement: 在装有25°C无菌过滤河水的九个玻璃培养皿中进行测试，每皿随机放入40个健康彭泽鲫卵，并以1×10^6/ml浓度的游动孢子悬浮液进行攻毒。
text_zh: 在装有25°C无菌过滤河水的九个玻璃培养皿中进行测试，每皿随机放入40个健康彭泽鲫卵，并以1×10^6/ml浓度的游动孢子悬浮液进行攻毒。
text_en: Tests were conducted in nine glass Petri dishes containing sterile filtered river water at 25°C, with 40 healthy Pengze crucian carp eggs randomly placed in each dish and challenged with a motile spore suspension at a concentration of 1×10^6/ml.

quote: Therefore, the recommended dietary protein for this new Carassius clone juvenile should be 21.38%–30.56%.
statement: 因此，这种新鲫鱼克隆幼鱼的推荐饲料蛋白应为21.38%–30.56%。
text_zh: 因此，这种新鲫鱼克隆幼鱼的推荐饲料蛋白应为21.38%–30.56%。
text_en: Therefore, the recommended dietary protein for these new crucian carp cloned juveniles should be 21.38%–30.56%.

quote: Dietary protein deficiency will slow down the fish growth,
statement: 膳食蛋白质缺乏会减缓鱼类生长。
text_zh: 膳食蛋白质缺乏会减缓鱼类生长。
text_en: Dietary protein deficiency slows fish growth.

quote: while excessive dietary protein will improve less or no more growth sometimes but also increase nitrogenous excretion and feed cost, leading to environmental loading and waste of resources
statement: 而过量的膳食蛋白质有时改善较少或不再促进生长，但也会增加氮排泄和饲料成本，导致环境负荷和资源浪费。
text_zh: 而过量的膳食蛋白质有时改善较少或不再促进生长，但也会增加氮排泄和饲料成本，导致环境负荷和资源浪费。
text_en: Excess dietary protein sometimes improves less or no longer promotes growth, but also increases nitrogen excretion and feed costs, leading to environmental load and resource waste.

quote: But fish growth is normally impaired by the high substitution of traditional proteins by novel proteins, and this dilemma limits their use in aquafeed
statement: 但传统蛋白质被新型蛋白质的高比例替代通常会损害鱼类生长，这一困境限制了它们在水产饲料中的使用。
text_zh: 但传统蛋白质被新型蛋白质的高比例替代通常会损害鱼类生长，这一困境限制了它们在水产饲料中的使用。
text_en: However, high-proportion replacement of traditional proteins with novel proteins usually impairs fish growth, a dilemma that limits their use in aquaculture feed.

quote: After 56-day rearing, no significant differences of final body weight (FBW) or survival rate (SR, while weight gain rate (WGR) and specific growth rate (SGR) were lower in the P30 group
statement: 经过56天的饲养，不同蛋白水平日粮组的最终体重和存活率无显著差异，但P30组的增重率和特定生长率较低。
text_zh: 经过56天的饲养，不同蛋白水平日粮组的最终体重和存活率无显著差异，但P30组的增重率和特定生长率较低。
text_en: After 56 days of rearing, there was no significant difference in final body weight and survival rate among the dietary groups with different protein levels, but the weight gain rate and specific growth rate were lower in the P30 group.

population.species: 双三倍体鲤克隆（amphitriploid Carassius clone）

quote: Feeding rate (FR) decreased as dietary protein level increased, and that of the P21 group was significantly higher than other groups
statement: 随着日粮蛋白水平的增加，摄食率下降，且P21组的摄食率显著高于其他组。
text_zh: 随着日粮蛋白水平的增加，摄食率下降，且P21组的摄食率显著高于其他组。
text_en: As dietary protein levels increased, feeding rates decreased, and the feeding rate of the P21 group was significantly higher than that of other groups.

population.species: 双三倍体鲤克隆（amphitriploid Carassius clone）

quote: The concentrations of ammonia and cortisol increased with dietary protein levels, with the highest values obtained in the P36 and P39 groups
statement: 氨和皮质醇的浓度随日粮蛋白水平的增加而升高，在P36和P39组中达到最高值。
text_zh: 氨和皮质醇的浓度随日粮蛋白水平的增加而升高，在P36和P39组中达到最高值。
text_en: The concentrations of ammonia and cortisol increased with increasing dietary protein levels, reaching the highest values in the P36 and P39 groups.

population.species: 优势三倍体鲫克隆鱼 (preponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone)

outcome: 应激反应与氮代谢废物

quote: hree fish were conducted to caudal blood sampling using 2-mL heparinized syringes and then centrifuged at 3000 rpm (850 g) for 15 min at 4°C, and the supernatants were separated and stored at −80°C for the measurement of plasma biochemical parameters.
statement: 三条鱼通过尾静脉采血，离心后分离上清液并储存于-80°C以测定血浆生化参数。
text_zh: 三条鱼通过尾静脉采血，离心后分离上清液并储存于-80°C以测定血浆生化参数。
text_en: Three fish were sampled via the caudal vein; after centrifugation, the supernatant was separated and stored at -80°C for determination of plasma biochemical parameters.

quote: Table 7 shows the whole body and muscle composition of the fish fed diets with different protein levels.
statement: 表7展示了饲喂不同蛋白质水平日粮的鱼的全身和肌肉组成。
text_zh: 表7展示了饲喂不同蛋白质水平日粮的鱼的全身和肌肉组成。
text_en: Table 7 shows the whole-body and muscle composition of fish fed diets with different protein levels.

quote: The activities of ALT increased with dietary protein levels, with higher value in the P36 group
statement: 随着日粮蛋白质水平的增加，ALT活性升高，且在P36组中数值较高。
text_zh: 随着日粮蛋白质水平的增加，ALT活性升高，且在P36组中数值较高。
text_en: As dietary protein levels increased, ALT activity increased, and the values were higher in the P36 group.

quote: The contents of MDA were higher in the P36 and P39 groups
statement: P36和P39组的MDA含量较高。
text_zh: P36和P39组的MDA含量较高。
text_en: The MDA content in groups P36 and P39 was higher.

quote: The activities of AST and the contents of HSP70 were not different between groups
statement: 各组间AST活性和HSP70含量无显著差异。
text_zh: 各组间AST活性和HSP70含量无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in AST activity and HSP70 content among the groups.
outcome: 肝脏酶活性与热休克蛋白

quote:
The death of dead test eggs was caused by
Saprolegnia sp., as determined by fungal isolation and molecular identification (data not
shown).
statement: 受试死卵的死亡是由水霉属真菌引起的，通过真菌分离和分子鉴定确定。
text_zh: 受试死卵的死亡是由水霉属真菌引起的，通过真菌分离和分子鉴定确定。
text_en: The death of the test dead eggs was caused by Saprolegnia fungi, determined through fungal isolation and molecular identification.

quote:
Thus, P. kaempferi is a potential drug for the successful treatment of
saprolegniasis of carp eggs.
statement: 因此，P. kaempferi是成功治疗鲤鱼卵水霉病的潜在药物。
text_zh: 因此，P. kaempferi是成功治疗鲤鱼卵水霉病的潜在药物。
text_en: Therefore, P. kaempferi is a potential drug for the successful treatment of Saprolegnia disease in carp eggs.

quote:
Our findings confirm
that Saprolegnia species are the major cause of saprolegniasis in aquaculture production
(Bangyeekhun, 2003).
statement: 研究结果证实水霉属是水产养殖生产中水霉病的主要原因。
text_zh: 研究结果证实水霉属是水产养殖生产中水霉病的主要原因。
text_en: The results confirmed that Saprolegnia is the main cause of saprolegniasis in aquaculture production.

quote: negative effects on muscle quality and organic health caused by excessive protein were normally ignored.
statement: 过量蛋白对肌肉质量和机体健康的负面影响通常被忽略。
text_zh: 过量蛋白对肌肉质量和机体健康的负面影响通常被忽略。
text_en: The negative effects of excess protein on muscle mass and body health are usually overlooked.

quote: During the 8-week rearing period... fish were fed to apparent satiation at 8:30, 13:30, and 16:30, and the uneaten feed were collected 0.5 h after each meal to obtain factual feed intake.
statement: 在8周的饲养期间，鱼每天在8:30、13:30和16:30被喂至表观饱食，并在每餐后0.5小时收集未食用的饲料以获取实际摄食量。
text_zh: 在8周的饲养期间，鱼每天在8:30、13:30和16:30被喂至表观饱食，并在每餐后0.5小时收集未食用的饲料以获取实际摄食量。
text_en: During the 8-week rearing period, fish were fed to apparent satiation daily at 8:30, 13:30 and 16:30, and uneaten feed was collected 0.5 hours after each meal to obtain actual feed intake.

quote: Dead fish were promptly removed and recorded.
statement: 死鱼被及时移除并记录。
text_zh: 死鱼被及时移除并记录。
text_en: Dead fish were promptly removed and recorded.

quote: The water temperature was recorded every morning and afternoon, which ranged within 26.4 ± 5.1°C.

text_zh: 水温每天上午和下午记录一次，范围在26.4 ± 5.1°C之间。
text_en: Water temperature was recorded once in the morning and once in the afternoon each day, ranging between 26.4 ± 5.1°C.

quote: The pH value, dissolved oxygen, and ammonia nitrogen concentrations were determined every fortnight. They were controlled at 7.44 ± 0.13, more than 6.08 mg/L, and less than 0.15 mg/L, respectively.
statement: 每两周测定pH值、溶解氧和氨氮浓度，分别控制在7.44 ± 0.13、高于6.08 mg/L和低于0.15 mg/L。

text_en: pH, dissolved oxygen, and ammonia nitrogen concentrations were measured every two weeks, controlled at 7.44 ± 0.13, above 6.08 mg/L, and below 0.15 mg/L, respectively.

text_en: The light intensity near the water surface is 100–120 lx, and residual chlorine is below 0.02 mg/L.

quote: After the feeding experiment, fish were imposed on a 24-h fasting, then anesthetized by MS-222 (50 mg/kg; tricaine methanesulfonate, Argent Chemical Laboratories Inc., Redmond, WA, USA), and bulk weighed.
statement: 喂养实验结束后，鱼被强制禁食24小时，然后使用MS-222（50 mg/kg）麻醉并进行整体称重。
text_zh: 喂养实验结束后，鱼被强制禁食24小时，然后使用MS-222（50 mg/kg）麻醉并进行整体称重。
text_en: After the feeding experiment ended, the fish were forcibly fasted for 24 hours, then anesthetized using MS-222 (50 mg/kg) and weighed as a whole.

quote: The present study found that the increased FR at low dietary protein could help maintain the new fish strain a normal growth by high feed intake when fed low dietary protein, but the feed conversion was still much lower.
statement: 本研究发现，在低膳食蛋白条件下，摄食率（FR）的增加通过高采食量有助于维持新鱼品系的正常生长，但饲料转化率仍然很低。
text_zh: 本研究发现，在低膳食蛋白条件下，摄食率（FR）的增加通过高采食量有助于维持新鱼品系的正常生长，但饲料转化率仍然很低。
text_en: This study found that under low dietary protein conditions, an increase in feeding rate (FR) helped maintain normal growth of the new fish strain through high feed intake, but the feed conversion ratio remained very low.

quote: Similar observation was reported in juvenile dotted gizzard shad (Konosirus punctatus) that the fish fed with 22.52% dietary protein grew as well as those fed with 45.78% by increasing feed intake [ 32 ].
statement: 据报道，幼年期斑鰶（Konosirus punctatus）通过增加采食量，以22.52%膳食蛋白喂养的鱼生长状况与以45.78%膳食蛋白喂养的鱼相当。
text_zh: 据报道，幼年期斑鰶（Konosirus punctatus）通过增加采食量，以22.52%膳食蛋白喂养的鱼生长状况与以45.78%膳食蛋白喂养的鱼相当。
text_en: It is reported that juvenile Konosirus punctatus, by increasing feed intake, showed growth performance comparable to fish fed a 45.78% dietary protein when fed a 22.52% dietary protein.

text_zh: 研究发现，该新品系在较低日粮蛋白水平下的生长率与较高日粮蛋白水平下的生长率相似。

text_en: This differs from the results reported by most studies, which indicate that low dietary protein leads to poor growth.

quote: The present study showed that the activities of plasma ALT and AST were not remarkably changed with the dietary protein level or the blood fat, implying that both high and low protein-contained diets would not affect the liver function of the new strain of preponderant amphitriploid Carassius clone
statement: 本研究表明，血浆ALT和AST活性未随日粮蛋白水平或血脂发生显著变化，这意味着高蛋白和低蛋白日粮均不会影响该新型双三倍体鲫克隆系的肝功能。
text_zh: 本研究表明，血浆ALT和AST活性未随日粮蛋白水平或血脂发生显著变化，这意味着高蛋白和低蛋白日粮均不会影响该新型双三倍体鲫克隆系的肝功能。
text_en: This study shows that plasma ALT and AST activities did not change significantly with dietary protein level or blood lipids, meaning that both high-protein and low-protein diets do not affect the liver function of this novel diploid-triploid hybrid crucian carp clone line.

quote: In the current study, although the content of HSP70 in the liver was impervious to the level of protein in diet, that of plasma cortisol was higher in high dietary protein groups, particularly in 37.87% and 40.70% protein, virtually in line with the results of plasma ammonia and MDA.
statement: 在本研究中，尽管肝脏中HSP70的含量不受日粮蛋白水平的影响，但高日粮蛋白组（特别是37.87%和40.70%蛋白）的血浆皮质醇水平较高，这与血浆氨和MDA的结果基本一致。
text_zh: 在本研究中，尽管肝脏中HSP70的含量不受日粮蛋白水平的影响，但高日粮蛋白组（特别是37.87%和40.70%蛋白）的血浆皮质醇水平较高，这与血浆氨和MDA的结果基本一致。
text_en: In this study, although hepatic HSP70 content was not affected by dietary protein level, plasma cortisol levels were higher in the high dietary protein group (particularly at 37.87% and 40.70% protein), which is generally consistent with the results for plasma ammonia and MDA.
